title: Active-Matter Battery
summary: Harnessing active matter to power functional devices has attracted growing interest. We propose a minimal battery model for storing energy extracted from active matter and derive its charging and discharging characteristics analytically. When the energetic cost of sustaining activity is included, the charging power-efficiency trade-off becomes loop-like and the efficiency attains a finite-time maximum, in sharp contrast to passive energy devices.

AI.tldr: 提出一个利用活性物质储能的最小电池模型，解析推导其充放电特性，发现充电功率-效率权衡呈环状且效率存在有限时间极大值。
AI.motivation: 利用活性物质为功能器件供能日益受关注，但缺乏对其储能过程的基本理论刻画与效率分析。
AI.method: 提出一个从活性物质中提取能量的最小电池模型，并解析求解其充电与放电特性，同时计入维持活性所需能量成本。
AI.result: 充电功率-效率权衡关系呈环状（loop-like），效率在有限时间内达到最大值。
AI.conclusion: 纳入活性维持成本后，活性物质电池表现出与被动能量器件截然不同的行为特征，需重新理解其效率优化与储能策略。

title: Generative Modeling of Stochastic Dynamics for Long-Time Evolution
summary: Exact stochastic equations for non-equilibrium dynamics are rarely accessible. We show that the long-time evolution of stochastic dynamics can be predicted from configuration pairs at a fixed short time lag, without knowledge of the equation of motion. Generative diffusion models learn the finite-time transition kernel from these pairs, and iterating it propagates the dynamics far beyond the training lag. For two-dimensional Model B, the diffusive dynamics of a conserved order parameter, the learned kernels reproduce dynamic critical scaling and self-similar $t^{1/3}$ coarsening. Agreement with direct simulations persists on lattices twice the largest training size and for initial ensembles absent from training. For driven colloids in a periodic optical potential, ten minutes of measured trajectories suffice to predict the particle current and mean passage time over the next twenty minutes within experimental uncertainty. Short-time observations thus contain the information needed to predict emergent non-equilibrium dynamics at much longer times.

AI.tldr: 从固定短时间迟滞的构型对出发，无需运动方程即可预测随机动力学的长时间演化；生成式扩散模型学习有限时间转移动核并迭代外推至远超训练迟滞。
AI.motivation: 非平衡动力学的精确随机方程往往难以获得，因此需要一种无需知道运动方程、仅凭短时观测就能预测长时间涌现行为的方法。
AI.method: 用生成式扩散模型从固定短时间迟滞的构型对中学习有限时间转移动核，再通过迭代该核将动力学传播到远超训练迟滞的时间尺度。
AI.result: 在二维Model B中，学习的核复现了动态临界标度和自相似t^{1/3}粗化，且在两倍最大训练尺寸的格子上及未见初始系综上仍与直接模拟一致；对周期光势中的驱动胶体，十分钟轨迹即可在实验误差内预测随后二十分钟的粒子流与平均通过时间。
AI.conclusion: 短时间观测已包含预测远长时间涌现非平衡动力学所需的信息。

title: The Ericson Transition in Time-Reversal Invariant Systems: Symplectically Invariant Hamiltonians
summary: We investigate the distributions of off-diagonal scattering matrix elements and cross-sections in the Ericson regime for time-reversal invariant systems with odd spin. Within the universal Heidelberg approach we prove that Gaussian and exponential behavior is found as the leading-order term of an asymptotic expansion of the aforementioned distributions. Furthermore, the subleading-order term is derived and compared with numerical simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究奇自旋、时间反演不变系统在Ericson区域的非对角散射矩阵元及截面分布，用Heidelberg方法证明其主导项为高斯和指数分布，并推导次主导项与数值模拟对比。
AI.motivation: 探索时间反演不变、奇自旋系统在Ericson区域的散射统计规律，明确非对角散射矩阵元与截面的分布形式。
AI.method: 采用普适Heidelberg方法（随机矩阵理论框架），对分布作渐近展开，推导主导项与次主导项。
AI.result: 证明主导项呈现高斯分布和指数分布；给出次主导项并与数值模拟进行比较。
AI.conclusion: Heidelberg方法可解析刻画该系统的Ericson涨落统计，理论渐近展开与数值模拟一致。

title: Tunable flat bands and their signatures in electronic specific heat of an Aharonov-Bohm triangular quantum network
summary: Quantum networks composed of loop-like structures provide a rich platform for exploring electronic transport phenomena and have been widely studied in various contexts. However, their thermal response remains relatively unexplored, motivating us to investigate it in the present work. We consider a tight-binding (TB) quantum network composed of a finite number of triangular plaquettes, where neighboring plaquettes are connected through single bonds and each triangular loop is threaded by an Aharonov-Bohm (AB) flux $φ$. The interplay of nonuniform site coordination, hopping asymmetry, and quantum interference gives rise to both dispersive and completely flat energy levels. We derive an analytical condition involving the TB parameters under which one of the energy branches becomes independent of the electronic momentum. We further show that the AB flux $φ$ provides a direct means of tuning the position of the flat band. The characteristic features of the energy spectrum associated with this quantum geometry are reflected in the thermal response, which we investigate through the electronic specific heat (ESH). In particular, we demonstrate that the position of the flat band manifests itself as a distinct feature in the ESH, establishing a direct connection between the flat-band formation and the thermal response of the system. Thus, the ESH provides an alternative route for identifying the presence of a flat band, consistent with the analytical condition and the corresponding energy dispersion. Moreover, the AB flux allows the ESH to be selectively regulated through the tuning of the flat-band position. The proposed approach provides a simple complementary means of identifying momentum-independent energy levels and may be extended to other simple and complex quantum networks supporting flat bands.

AI.tldr: 研究了由三角环组成的紧束缚量子网络的热响应，发现平带位置会在电子比热中留下特征，且可通过AB磁通调控。
AI.motivation: 由环状结构构成的量子网络在电子输运方面研究广泛，但其热响应尚不清楚，故本文展开探究。
AI.method: 构建由有限个三角plaquette组成的紧束缚网络，相邻plaquette以单键连接，每个三角环穿过AB磁通φ，解析推导平带形成的参数条件。
AI.result: 非均匀配位、跳跃不对称与量子干涉导致色散与非色散能级共存；给出能量支与动量无关的解析条件；AB磁通可调控平带位置；平带位置在电子比热(ESH)中表现为明显特征。
AI.conclusion: 电子比热可作为识别平带的替代手段，AB磁通使其可选择性调控，该方法可推广到其他含平带的简单与复杂量子网络。

title: Electronic structure and two-orbital model of the quadlayer La$_5$Ni$_4$O$_{13}$
summary: The discovery of pressure-induced superconductivity in Ruddlesden--Popper (RP) nickelates has stimulated extensive interest in high-T$_c$ superconductors. Here, we systematically study the electronic properties of the quadlayer RP nickelate La$_5$Ni$_4$O$_{13}$ under ambient pressure, 5% isotropic compressive strain, and 4% $c$-axis uniaxial strain using density functional theory (DFT) and random phase approximation (RPA) calculations. DFT calculations show that isotropic strain broadens the Ni-$e_g$ bands and induces charge transfer from O-$p$ to Ni-$d$ orbitals, whereas $c$-axis uniaxial strain selectively shifts the $d_{z^2}$-derived bonding1 band upward while leaving the $d_{x^2-y^2}$ dispersion nearly unchanged. From Wannier downfolding, we construct a quadlayer two-orbital model that reproduces the low-energy Ni-$e_g$ bands. Our model reveals that under ambient pressure and 5% isotropic strain, the Fermi surface consists of two electron pockets ($α$ and $δ$) and three hole pockets ($β$, $β^{\prime}$, and $β^{\prime \prime}$), while under uniaxial strain, a $γ$ hole pocket with $d_{z^2}$ orbital character emerges. RPA calculations reveal that the leading spin response shifts from $\mathbf{q}\approx(2π/3,2π/3)$ at ambient pressure to $\mathbf{q}\approx(π,π)$ under both strain conditions and is enhanced under $c$-axis compression. These results suggest that $c$-axis compression may provide a favorable route to superconductivity in the quadlayer nickelate analogous to that in bilayer and trilayer nickelates.

AI.tldr: 本文用DFT和RPA系统研究了四层RP镍酸盐La5Ni4O13在常压、5%各向同性压缩应变和4% c轴单轴应变下的电子性质，构建了四层双轨道模型，发现c轴压缩可将自旋响应移至(π,π)并增强，可能有利于超导。
AI.motivation: RP镍酸盐中压力诱导超导的发现激发了高温超导研究兴趣，但四层RP镍酸盐La5Ni4O13在应变/压力下的电子结构及自旋涨落尚不清晰。
AI.method: 采用DFT与RPA计算，对比常压、5%各向同性压缩应变和4% c轴单轴应变；通过Wannier下折叠构建四层双轨道（Ni-eg）模型，并计算费米面与自旋响应。
AI.result: 各向同性应变展宽Ni-eg能带并引起O-p到Ni-d电荷转移；c轴单轴应变上移dz2成键带而基本不改变dx2-y2色散。常压与5%各向同性应变下费米面含两个电子口袋(α,δ)和三个空穴口袋(β,β',β'')，单轴应变下出现dz2特征的γ空穴口袋。主导自旋响应由常压的(2π/3,2π/3)转为两种应变下的(π,π)，并在c轴压缩下增强。
AI.conclusion: c轴压缩可能是使四层镍酸盐实现超导的有利途径，类似双层和三层镍酸盐的情况。

title: Emergence of electronic modes and triplet pairing from spin-1 antiferromagnetic insulators in the Kanamori-Hubbard model
summary: The electronic band structures of conventional band insulators generally remain unchanged under doping via chemical-potential shifts or increasing temperature. However, in Mott and Kondo insulators described by models such as the Hubbard and Kondo lattice models, distinct electronic modes with momentum-shifted magnetic dispersion relations have been shown to emerge from band edges into the gap. Here, by investigating the two-orbital Kanamori-Hubbard model, this study elucidates how and why the band structures of spin-1 antiferromagnetic insulators change with doping and temperature, revealing emergent spectral features characteristic of orbitally degenerate systems. The nature of the emergent electronic modes is clarified using weak-hopping effective theory, selection-rule analysis, and numerical calculations. In a typical parameter regime, the doping-induced modes in each orbital reflect distinct types of spin modes, while the temperature-induced modes primarily reflect the low-energy spin mode in both orbitals; in both cases, the emergent modes exhibit momentum-shifted spin-mode dispersion relations. The momentum regimes of these emergent modes can differ between orbitals if signs of the hopping parameters differ. For small inter-orbital repulsion, onsite spin-triplet pairs can form after doping, leading to a pair-breaking gap, while the temperature-induced electronic modes continue to reflect the low-energy spin mode without a pair-breaking gap. Moreover, the emergence and characteristics of electronic modes in nonequilibrium states by spin or charge perturbations are elucidated. These findings provide a comprehensive understanding of how the interplay among the spin, charge, and orbital degrees of freedom in large-spin antiferromagnetic insulators leads to emergent electronic modes, opening avenues for exploring unconventional quantum phenomena in strongly correlated systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究双轨道Kanamori-Hubbard模型，揭示自旋-1反铁磁绝缘体在掺杂和温度变化时，从能隙边缘涌现出具有动量平移自旋色散关系的电子模式，并阐明其与自旋、电荷、轨道自由度的关联。
AI.motivation: 传统带绝缘体在掺杂（化学势移动）或升温时能带结构基本不变；而在Mott与Kondo绝缘体中会出现源于带边、进入能隙的动量平移磁色散电子模式。作者希望理解大自旋反铁磁绝缘体（自旋-1，轨道简并体系）中这些涌现模式的成因与特征。
AI.method: 采用双轨道Kanamori-Hubbard模型，结合弱跳跃有效理论、选择定则分析以及数值计算，研究掺杂与温度诱导的电子模式及其与自旋模式的对应关系；同时分析小轨道间库仑排斥下的自旋三重态配对，以及自旋/电荷扰动下的非平衡态电子模式。
AI.result: 典型参数下，掺杂诱导的模式在各轨道反映不同类型的自旋模式，而温度诱导的模式主要反映两个轨道中的低能自旋模式，两者均呈现动量平移的自旋色散关系。若跳跃参数符号不同，涌现模式的动量区间可在轨道间不同。小轨道间排斥时，掺杂可形成在位自旋三重态对，产生破对能隙；而温度诱导模式则无破对能隙。此外还阐明了自旋或电荷扰动下非平衡态电子模式的涌现与特征。
AI.conclusion: 研究全面揭示了大自旋反铁磁绝缘体中自旋、电荷与轨道自由度相互作用如何导致涌现电子模式，为探索强关联体系中的非常规量子现象开辟了新途径。

title: Transferable Graph Neural Network Surrogates for Molecular Dynamics Across Crystal Symmetries
summary: We present a transferable graph neural network (GNN) surrogate framework for molecular dynamics (MD) that directly predicts atomic displacements and propagates atomistic configurations without explicit force evaluation or numerical time integration. The central objective of this work is to establish whether a common GNN formulation can represent atomic dynamics across materials with fundamentally different crystal symmetries and coordination environments. The same network architecture, feature representation, graph construction, and training protocol are applied without symmetry-specific modification to face-centered cubic (FCC) aluminum, body-centered cubic (BCC) iron, and hexagonal close-packed (HCP) magnesium. Across these distinct elemental and crystallographic systems, the framework achieves position-prediction errors on the order of 10^-4 Angstrom^2 and supports stable autoregressive propagation to nanosecond time scales. The predicted trajectories preserve thermodynamic stability, characteristic coordination-shell structure in the radial distribution functions, and temperature-dependent mean-squared-displacement behavior. In particular, the framework captures the closely spaced coordination shells of BCC iron and the anisotropic coordination environment of HCP magnesium without introducing lattice-specific representations. These results demonstrate that direct GNN-based atomic propagation can be formulated as a transferable framework across different elements, lattice symmetries, and coordination geometries, providing a pathway toward generalizable surrogate models for accelerated molecular dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出可迁移的GNN代理框架，直接预测原子位移进行分子动力学模拟，在FCC铝、BCC铁、HCP镁上统一架构实现纳秒级稳定传播。
AI.motivation: 验证一个通用GNN公式能否在晶体对称性和配位环境根本不同的多种材料中表征原子动力学，从而走向可泛化的分子动力学代理模型。
AI.method: 采用同一网络架构、特征表示、图构建和训练协议，无需对称性特定修改，直接预测原子位移并自回归传播构型，不显式计算力或数值积分。应用于FCC铝、BCC铁、HCP镁。
AI.result: 位置预测误差约10^-4 Å²，支持纳秒级稳定自回归传播；轨迹保持热力学稳定性、径向分布函数的配位壳层结构及温度相关均方位移行为，并捕捉BCC铁密集配位壳与HCP镁各向异性配位环境。
AI.conclusion: 直接GNN原子传播可作为跨元素、晶格对称性与配位几何的可迁移框架，为加速分子动力学的通用代理模型提供途径。

title: Strictly Localized Molecular Orbitals: Non-Orthogonal Local Orbitals Built with Chemical Intuition
summary: We propose the use of an a priori localization method based on separating the molecule into fragments to generate a wavefunction suitable for post Hartree-Fock methods. A quasi-Newton approach utilizing Thouless rotation is developed to optimize the strictly localized molecular orbitals(sLMO). We discuss the properties of the sLMO-HF wavefunction and compare it to the tail deleted a posteriori localization methods that are usually done in preparation of post Hartree-Fock methods. We then discuss the effects of choosing different fragmentation patterns and basis sets.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于分子分片的先验局域化方法，通过准牛顿结合Thouless旋转优化严格局域分子轨道（sLMO），为后Hartree-Fock方法生成波函数，并与尾部截断的后验局域化方法比较，讨论分片模式与基组的影响。
AI.motivation: 后Hartree-Fock方法通常需要先将正则分子轨道局域化（后验局域化），并做尾部截断处理，这种做法存在局限。本文希望从先验角度，通过将分子分成片段直接生成适合后HF方法的局域波函数。
AI.method: 将分子分为片段，构造严格局域分子轨道（sLMO）；采用基于Thouless旋转的准牛顿法对sLMO进行优化；分析sLMO-HF波函数的性质，并与通常在准备后HF方法时使用的尾部截断后验局域化方法进行对比；考察不同分片模式和基组选择的影响。
AI.result: 给出了sLMO-HF波函数的性质刻画；展示了其与尾部截断后验局域化方法的比较结果；说明不同分片模式和基组选择会对结果产生影响。
AI.conclusion: 先验分片局域化结合Thouless旋转准牛顿优化可生成适用于后HF方法的局域波函数，是一种可替代传统后验局域化加尾部截断的方案，且分片模式与基组的选择需谨慎考虑。

title: From Energy-Force Weighting to Primal-Dual Optimization of Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
summary: Machine-learned interatomic potentials are commonly fitted by weighted-sum scalarization, which combines energy and force errors in a single loss. A nominal weight, however, identifies a potential only relative to the complete fitting protocol. We therefore treat energy--force balancing as a protocol-dependent problem of physical model selection. For fixed-basis atomic cluster expansion models of molten LiCl, liquid H$_2$O, and Si, the resulting scalarization paths contain dominated states at extreme weights. Their nondominated subsets depend on the solver, and the out-of-distribution Si path is nonmonotone. We replace direct weight selection by minimizing the regularized energy objective subject to an upper bound on the normalized force loss. Projected dual ascent adjusts the Lagrange multiplier from the force-constraint residual. A frozen-multiplier limited-memory quasi-Newton refinement then returns the final model. Across the three systems, the constrained procedure reaches the solver-matched low-error region and gives measured speedups of $6.7$--$8.9$ over completed scalarization scans under the stated timing convention. Physical-property calculations show that first-shell geometry is comparatively insensitive to the selected balance, whereas transport and solid-state observables vary more strongly. These results identify the fitted model--protocol pair as the relevant object of energy--force model selection and support force-constrained fitting as an explicit selection rule.

AI.tldr: 将能量-力平衡视为依赖拟合协议的物理模型选择问题，用受约束优化替代直接权重选择，取得6.7-8.9倍加速。
AI.motivation: 常用加权和标量化拟合机器学习势，但标称权重仅在完整拟合协议下才有意义；能量-力平衡本质上是协议依赖的物理模型选择问题。极端权重下存在被支配状态，非支配子集依赖求解器，分布外Si路径还非单调。
AI.method: 以固定基的原子团簇展开模型为对象（熔融LiCl、液态H2O、Si），用"最小化正则化能量目标 + 归一化力损失上界"的约束问题替代直接权重选择；用投影对偶上升由力约束残差调整拉格朗日乘子，再用冻结乘子的L-BFGS精修得到最终模型。
AI.result: 三个体系上约束流程均到达与求解器匹配的低误差区域，相比完整标量化扫描测得6.7-8.9倍加速（给定计时约定）。物性计算显示第一壳层几何对所选平衡较不敏感，而输运与固态可观测量变化更强。
AI.conclusion: 拟合模型-协议对才是能量-力模型选择的相关对象，支持将力约束拟合作为显式选择规则。

title: CTMRG as a tensor-network message-passing algorithm
summary: We formulate the corner transfer matrix equations, and the corner transfer matrix renormalization group built on them, as a set of local equations on general planar graphs. These equations depend only on the local subgraphs of the planar graph and are glued together consistently to describe the whole graph. Solving them yields message tensors and corner matrices, which can be used to construct an MPS environment for any connected subgraph. We test the proposed equations on the ferromagnetic Ising model, on a variety of infinite lattices (including hyperbolic ones) and on finite graphs, and find systematic improvement over belief propagation.

AI.tldr: 将角转移矩阵方程与CTMRG推广为定义在一般平面图上的局域方程，求解得到message张量与corner矩阵，可构造任意连通子图的MPS环境。
AI.motivation: 传统角转移矩阵（CTM）与CTMRG通常定义在规则格子上，如何将这套框架推广到一般平面图并统一描述是本文动机。
AI.method: 把CTM方程与CTMRG表述为依赖平面图局域子图的局域方程组，通过一致粘合描述整图，求解得到message张量和corner矩阵，进而构造任意连通子图的MPS环境。
AI.result: 在铁磁Ising模型上测试，涵盖多种无限格子（含双曲格子）与有限图，结果相对belief propagation有系统性改进。
AI.conclusion: 该局域化CTMRG框架适用于一般平面图，优于belief propagation，为图上的张量网络环境构造提供统一方法。

title: Interior contacts in a narrow quantum Hall bar: a two-dimensional self-consistent screening calculation of the current distribution
comment: 11 Figures, floow up of NatComm. Paper
summary: We present fully two-dimensional self-consistent calculations of the electron density, local filling factor and current distribution in a six-terminal GaAs/AlGaAs Hall bar of width W = 3 micrometers with two additional square contacts, A and B, placed on the channel axis and connected to the outside by air bridges, following the interior-contact experiment of Kendirlik et al. [Nat. Commun. 8, 14082 (2017)]. Within the screening theory of the integer quantized Hall effect, the Thomas-Fermi-Poisson equations are solved on the full device plane, including the probe arms and the depletion regions around the interior contacts, and the current is obtained from a local Ohm's law with a filling-factor dependent conductivity tensor, for source-drain and interior-contact excitation separately. Across the nu = 2 plateau the interior contacts pass through three regimes as the field is lowered: galvanically connected to the current path in a compressible bulk, floating in the Hall potential of a fully incompressible bulk, and isolated from both the bulk and the edge strips by closed incompressible rings encircling each contact. In the floating and isolated regimes the two-terminal resistance between the interior contacts rises by orders of magnitude. The isolation interval lies within the Hall plateau and ends before its low-field edge; its high-field end is sharply set by the disappearance of the incompressible bulk, while its low-field end shrinks with temperature and Landau-level broadening. The resistance between an interior contact and a perimeter probe approaches one half of the quantized Hall resistance across the plateau. The topology of the incompressible regions and the boundaries of the isolation interval are insensitive to the regularization of the local conductivity, to the grid and to moderate disorder, whereas the magnitude of the isolation resistance is not.

AI.tldr: 本文用二维自洽Thomas-Fermi-Poisson计算，研究带内部触点的六端Hall bar在量子Hall平台区的电子密度、填充因子与电流分布，揭示内部触点依次经历电导连通、浮动和隔离三个区间。
AI.motivation: 基于Kendirlik等人的内部触点实验，需要在筛分理论框架下对包含内部触点、探头臂和耗尽区的完整器件进行二维自洽建模，以理解内部触点电阻在量子Hall平台区的异常行为。
AI.method: 在完整器件平面（含探头臂及内部触点周围耗尽区）求解Thomas-Fermi-Poisson方程，得到电子密度和局域填充因子；采用填充因子相关电导张量的局域Ohm定律计算电流，分别考虑源漏激发和内部触点激发。
AI.result: 在nu=2平台随磁场降低，内部触点经历三个区间：可压缩体内电导连通、完全不可压缩体内的Hall电位中浮动、被包围触点的闭合不可压缩环隔离。浮动和隔离区两触点间电阻上升数个量级；隔离区间位于Hall平台内、止于低场边缘，高场端由不可压缩体消失决定，低场端随温度和朗道能级展宽缩小；内部触点与周界探头间电阻趋近量子Hall电阻的一半。
AI.conclusion: 不可压缩区拓扑和隔离区间边界对电导正则化、网格和适度无序不敏感，但隔离电阻量级对这些因素敏感。

title: Highly anisotropic collective modes of altermagnetic superconductors with Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces
summary: We investigate collective modes in charge-neutral altermagnetic superconductors with $d$-wave spin-split bands, focusing on the impact of emergent Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces. In the absence of a magnetic field, the BCS state supports collective modes that inherit the underlying $d$-wave symmetry, resulting in pronounced momentum-space anisotropy. The broken time-reversal symmetry further couples these modes to spin-density fluctuations, allowing their signatures to emerge in the spin dynamical structure factor. Upon applying a magnetic field, Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces emerge and qualitatively reshape the collective-mode dynamics through gapless particle-hole excitations and strongly anisotropic Landau damping. The damping is strongest along the momentum-space diagonal, where it can suppress the low-energy phonon mode at small momenta. Remarkably, the suppressed phonon is accompanied by the emergence of an in-gap structure in the Higgs mode and an associated pronounced enhancement of the spin response. These results establish Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces as a mechanism for generating highly anisotropic collective-mode dynamics and identify spin response as a sensitive probe of in-gap Higgs excitations in altermagnetic superconductors.

AI.tldr: 研究d波自旋劈裂交替磁超导体中的集体模式，重点分析磁场诱导的Bogoliubov费米面如何通过无隙粒子-空穴激发和各向异性Landau阻尼重塑集体模式动力学。
AI.motivation: 探索交替磁超导体中Bogoliubov费米面对集体模式（声子、Higgs模、自旋涨落）的影响，揭示其高度各向异性的动力学机制，并寻找探测隙内Higgs激发的灵敏探针。
AI.method: 理论分析电荷中性交替磁超导体（具d波自旋劈裂能带）：无磁场时分析BCS态的集体模式及其与自旋密度涨落的耦合；施加磁场后引入Bogoliubov费米面，计算无隙粒子-空穴激发与各向异性Landau阻尼，并考察动量空间对角线方向的阻尼效应。
AI.result: 无磁场时集体模式继承d波对称性，呈显著动量空间各向异性，且因时间反演对称破缺耦合自旋密度涨落而出现在自旋动态结构因子中；加磁场后Bogoliubov费米面产生无隙激发与强各向异性阻尼，在对角线方向最强，可在小动量处压制低能声子模，同时伴随Higgs模出现隙内结构及自旋响应显著增强。
AI.conclusion: Bogoliubov费米面是产生高度各向异性集体模式动力学的机制，自旋响应可作为交替磁超导体中隙内Higgs激发的灵敏探针。

title: Causality violations in cluster GW+DMFT: Exact Lehmann moments and the necessity of non-local vertex corrections
summary: The $GW$ approximation is known to violate causality, yielding self-energies with unphysical poles in the upper half of the complex frequency plane. The combined $GW$+DMFT approach attempts to cure this by injecting the exact local self-energy. Using exact diagonalization on minimal Hubbard clusters, we rigorously benchmark the analytic structure of the $GW$ and $GW$+DMFT self-energies. We demonstrate a ``dimer anomaly'': on the two-site dimer, inversion symmetry forces the non-local self-energy to be purely real, masking the causality violation. Moving to the non-bipartite three-site Hubbard ring, where hopping frustration yields a finite imaginary part in the non-local self-energy, we prove that both $GW$ and $GW$+DMFT violate the Matsubara causality condition. By analytically evaluating the exact Lehmann moments, we derive a closed-form expression for the high-frequency tail of the self-energy, $C = U^2\,\mathrm{Var}(d)\,I$, and show that standard methods fail to capture the exact equal-time two-particle correlators required to enforce it. The equal-time correlators that govern this tail are precisely those encoded in the high-frequency asymptotics of the fully irreducible vertex $Λ$; nevertheless, our intermediate-frequency analysis demonstrates that the local-only truncation of $Λ$ in $GW$+DMFT leaves non-local RPA resonances uncorrected. The two diagnostics are logically independent: $GW$+DMFT satisfies the necessary high-frequency condition $C\succeq0$ yet still violates the Matsubara sign condition at finite frequencies. Taking the interpolation-free real-axis evaluation of the exact self-energy as the primary causality certificate, with rational continuation as supporting evidence, we establish a rigorous benchmark demonstrating that local self-energy corrections are insufficient to guarantee a causal analytic structure on frustrated clusters.

AI.tldr: 该文用精确对角化在最小Hubbard团簇上严格检验GW与GW+DMFT自能的解析结构，发现两者在阻挫团簇上均违反Matsubara因果性，证明局域自能修正不足以保证因果性。
AI.motivation: GW近似已知违反因果性，会在复频率上半平面产生非物理极点；GW+DMFT试图通过注入精确局域自能来修正这一问题，但其能否真正恢复因果性尚缺乏严格检验，尤其在阻挫体系中。
AI.method: 在最小Hubbard团簇（二聚体与三格点环）上做精确对角化，严格分析GW与GW+DMFT自能的解析结构；通过解析计算精确Lehmann矩，推导自能高频尾的闭式表达，并考察完全不可约顶点Λ的高频渐近与中频行为。
AI.result: 发现“二聚体反常”：二聚体上反演对称迫使非局域自能为实，掩盖了因果性破坏。在非二分三格点阻挫环上，证明GW与GW+DMFT均违反Matsubara因果条件；高频条件C=U²Var(d)I虽被GW+DMFT满足（C⪰0），但有限频率下Matsubara符号条件仍被违反，且局域Λ截断未修正非局域RPA共振。
AI.conclusion: 两个诊断逻辑独立：满足高频必要条件并不保证有限频率因果性。以无插值的实轴精确自能评估为主要因果性证书，局域自能修正不足以保证阻挫团簇上的因果解析结构。

title: Thermodynamic origins of multimode spinodal decomposition in multicomponent alloys
summary: In a binary alloy, spinodal decomposition has one composition direction in which the free energy can fall. A multicomponent alloy has more directions available, yet its elements usually separate together in a single, pseudobinary mode. Why does this happen, and what would allow two independent directions to become unstable? We examine these questions using binary interaction parameters and the composition-constrained curvature of the regular-solution free energy. Across equimolar BCC quaternaries, one unstable mode is the most common outcome at 500 K, while 15.2% have at least two. The tendency of unlike elements to mix helps explain the preference for one mode. We then show how particular arrangements of interactions, including a balanced repulsive triangle and an attractive-repulsive pair, guarantee two downhill directions. When those directions have similar strengths, simplified phase-field models produce a broad texture of locally different solid solutions rather than two chemical blocks. A phase-specific screen identifies five provisional alloys with nearly balanced modes, with Cu-In-Ir-Ti providing an example of this possibility. Thus, we establish a theoretical framework for engineering microstructures via spinodal decomposition derived from basic binary interaction tendencies.

AI.tldr: 该文研究多元合金旋节分解为何通常只沿单一伪二元模式进行，以及如何实现两个独立失稳方向，并建立基于二元相互作用参数的理论框架。
AI.motivation: 二元合金旋节分解只有一个成分下降方向，而多元合金理论上可有多方向，但实际常表现为单一伪二元分离。作者希望解释这一现象并寻找使两个独立方向同时失稳的条件。
AI.method: 采用规则溶体自由能的成分约束曲率与二元相互作用参数，分析等摩尔BCC四元合金的失稳模式，并用简化相场模型模拟双方向失稳的微观组织，最后进行相特异性筛选。
AI.result: 500 K下等摩尔BCC四元合金多表现为单一失稳模式，仅15.2%存在至少两个失稳方向；异类元素混合倾向偏向单模式。平衡排斥三角和吸引-排斥对可保证双下降方向。当两方向强度相近时，相场模型产生局部成分不同的宽泛织构而非两个化学块。筛选出五个近平衡模式候选合金，Cu-In-Ir-Ti为例。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了通过旋节分解工程化微观组织的理论框架，可从基本二元相互作用倾向预测和设计多方向失稳合金。

title: Utilizing a Perturbative Inverse of the Hamiltonian to Improve Lanczos Diagonalization
summary: The use of the shifted inverse Hamiltonian in the Lanczos algorithm is examined. We present a perturbative inverse and demonstrate that the Krylov subspace formed from it is better suited to approximating the ground state wavefunction compared with the Hamiltonian itself. We further demonstrate that the perturbative inverse provides an adequately accurate approximation to the inverse Hamiltonian at second order. Naturally, the quality of the results depend on the quality of the initial guess, here we use the Hartree-Fock, CISD, MP-PT1, and EN-PT1 wavefunctions. Lastly, we examine the scaling of the method where we find that accurate results can be found for similar cost as PT5.

AI.tldr: 本文将微扰逆哈密顿量用于Lanczos算法，其形成的Krylov子空间比原始哈密顿量更适合近似基态波函数，且二阶微扰逆已足够精确。结果质量取决于初始猜测（HF、CISD、MP-PT1、EN-PT1），精度相当PT5且成本相近。
AI.motivation: Lanczos算法基于原始哈密顿量构建Krylov子空间近似基态，收敛和精度可能受限，本文探索用移位逆哈密顿量改善基态波函数的近似效果。
AI.method: 采用移位逆哈密顿量进行Lanczos计算，提出微扰逆方法并证明其二阶近似已足够准确；以Hartree-Fock、CISD、MP-PT1和EN-PT1波函数作为初始猜测，研究该方法的标度行为。
AI.result: 由微扰逆形成的Krylov子空间比原始哈密顿量更能有效近似基态；微扰逆在二阶即可充分近似逆哈密顿量；结果质量依赖初始猜测；达到与PT5相当的成本即可获得准确结果。
AI.conclusion: 移位逆哈密顿量结合Lanczos算法能更高效地近似基态，微扰逆（二阶）是可行方案，且成本与PT5相当，具有实际应用潜力。

title: Automated Many-Body Simulations of Strongly Correlated Systems Using a Correlation-Aware Agentic Framework
summary: We present CAFES, a correlation-aware agentic framework for electronic-structure simulations of strongly correlated systems. CAFES addresses two challenges: the fragmented software landscape for many-body calculations and the difficulty of selecting appropriate methods across diverse correlation regimes. It combines correlation diagnostics, adaptive method selection, and large language model (LLM) assistance for molecular, crystalline, and model-Hamiltonian systems. A study-task architecture separates study-level planning from task-level execution, while a curated scientific knowledge layer provides reusable guidance for method selection, workflow design, and result interpretation. We demonstrate CAFES through three research-level studies: calculating the low-lying electronic states of lutein using DMRG-CASSCF, probing phase competition in the extended honeycomb Hubbard model using DMET, and generating a quantum-chemical dataset with CCSD labels. These calculations demonstrate the potential of agentic workflows for strongly correlated electronic-structure problems, a regime that has received limited attention in existing agentic computational frameworks.

AI.tldr: CAFES是一个面向强关联体系电子结构模拟的关联感知智能体框架，整合关联诊断、自适应方法选择与LLM辅助，并在三项研究级案例中验证了其有效性与潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有问题有二：多体计算软件生态碎片化，且在不同关联区域下难以选择合适的计算方法。此外，现有智能体计算框架对强关联电子结构问题的关注有限。
AI.method: 提出CAFES框架，结合关联诊断、自适应方法选择与LLM辅助，支持分子、晶体及模型哈密顿体系。采用"研究-任务"两层架构，将研究级规划与任务级执行分离，并构建经整理的科学知识层，为方法选择、工作流设计与结果解读提供可复用指导。
AI.result: 通过三项研究级案例验证：用DMRG-CASSCF计算叶黄素低激发电子态；用DMET探究扩展蜂窝Hubbard模型中的相竞争；生成带CCSD标签的量子化学数据集。
AI.conclusion: 结果展示了智能体工作流在强关联电子结构问题上的潜力，填补了现有智能体计算框架在此类体系上的空白。

title: Thermal entanglement transitions from strong $\textrm{SU}(2)$ symmetry
summary: We study mixed-state entanglement in Gibbs states with strong $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ symmetry, focusing on locally interacting spin systems with ferromagnetic interactions. Our main result is to show that finite-temperature ordering transitions are associated with entanglement transitions, and therefore the steady state of strongly symmetric Lindbladians can exhibit entanglement transitions. While in the paramagnetic phase it is known that the distillable entanglement and logarithmic entanglement negativity between two halves of a large system grow logarithmically with the square root of the number of spins, we show that in ferromagnetic phases these quantities grow parametrically faster with system size. To arrive at this result we first establish relations between these mixed-state entanglement measures and spin correlations in states that are singlets under global $\rm{SU}(2)$ symmetry transformations. We then introduce a semiclassical theory for $\rm{SU}(2)$ singlet thermal states. While the global singlet constraint generally enters this theory as a complicated function of the full semiclassical spin configuration, we show that in large $S$ limit it simplifies drastically to a Gaussian suppression of total magnetization in disordered phases as well as in ordered phases in the vicinity of continuous thermal phase transitions. This leads us to a field theory describing spin correlations in the singlet sector. Using this we determine the behavior of various probes of mixed-state entanglement at low and at high temperatures, supporting our analytical results using numerical Monte Carlo simulations of a three-dimensional lattice realization of our semiclassical theory. We also use exact numerics in one-dimensional spin-$1/2$ systems to confirm our predictions for the scaling of mixed-state entanglement with correlation length and system size in the paramagnetic phase.

AI.tldr: 该文研究强SU(2)对称铁磁自旋系统中Gibbs态的混合态纠缠，发现有限温度有序相变伴随纠缠相变，铁磁相纠缠随系统尺寸增长远快于顺磁相。
AI.motivation: 探究有限温度有序相变是否伴随纠缠相变，以及强对称Lindbladian稳态能否出现纠缠相变。
AI.method: 建立混合态纠缠度量与全局SU(2)单态自旋关联的关系；提出SU(2)单态热态的半经典理论，在大S极限下简化为总磁化的高斯抑制，导出描述单态自旋关联的场论；结合蒙特卡洛模拟及一维自旋1/2精确数值验证。
AI.result: 证明有限温度有序相变与纠缠相变相关联；顺磁相中可提纯纠缠与对数负度随自旋数平方根对数增长，而铁磁相中随系统尺寸增长参数上更快；数值模拟支持解析结果。
AI.conclusion: 强对称铁磁系统中的热相变对应纠缠相变，铁磁相纠缠增长机制不同于顺磁相，为强对称Lindbladian稳态纠缠相变提供理论支持。

title: From Quantized Hall Plateaus to Topological Surfaces: Quantum Capacitance as a Unifying Probe
summary: The quantum Hall effect, topological insulators and quantum capacitance are usually treated as distinct topics, yet they share a common thread. Bulk topology determines a protected boundary state, and quantum capacitance is one of the few electrostatic methods able to detect the density of states. This paper examines that connection. The integer quantum Hall effect showed that quantised boundary transport has a topological origin given by the Chern number, later extended to zero field in Z2 topological insulators with helical edge and Dirac surface states. Quantum capacitance, developed for two-dimensional electron gases, has since become a key technique for mapping the Landau level density of states underlying the quantum Hall effect and the linear Dirac density of states of topological surface states. This picture is complicated by self-consistent screening theory, which shows that the quantum Hall bulk splits into compressible and incompressible regions that shift with field. Local quantum capacitance measurements confirm that the bulk is not uniformly insulating across a quantised plateau, even though the plateau stays quantised. The paper argues that quantum capacitance is not a secondary feature of these phenomena but one of the clearest windows into the boundary density of states that topology imposes, and that it reveals the local, field-dependent nature of the insulating bulk assumption underlying the analogy between the quantum Hall effect and topological insulators.

AI.tldr: 本文论证量子电容是探测拓扑所强加的边界态密度的最清晰窗口之一，并揭示量子霍尔效应与拓扑绝缘体类比中"绝缘体"假设的局域性与磁场依赖性。
AI.motivation: 量子霍尔效应、拓扑绝缘体与量子电容通常被当作互不相干的课题，但三者共享一条主线：体态拓扑决定受保护的边界态，而量子电容是少数能探测态密度的静电手段之一。本文旨在阐明这一内在联系。
AI.method: 通过综述整数量子霍尔效应的陈数拓扑起源及其在Z2拓扑绝缘体（螺旋边缘态与狄拉克表面态）中的零场推广，并结合量子电容技术对朗道能级态密度和拓扑表面态线性狄拉克态密度的映射，同时引入自洽屏蔽理论分析体态的分裂行为。
AI.result: 自洽屏蔽理论表明量子霍尔体态分裂为可压缩与不可压缩区域，且随磁场移动；局域量子电容测量证实，在量子化平台范围内体态并非均匀绝缘，尽管平台仍保持量子化。
AI.conclusion: 量子电容并非这些现象的次要特征，而是洞察拓扑所强加边界态密度的最清晰窗口之一，同时揭示了量子霍尔效应与拓扑绝缘体类比中绝缘体假设的局域、磁场依赖本质。

title: Selective suppression of electronic orders via interlayer coupling in superconducting bilayer nickelate thin films
summary: The discovery of spin-density-wave (SDW) order in bilayer nickelates has intensified interest in its interplay with superconductivity. Unlike cuprates, where doping rapidly suppresses the Néel temperature, the SDW transition temperature ($T_{\mathrm{SDW}}$) in bilayer nickelates is robust against oxygen annealing and even increases under pressure. Here, we combine oxygen annealing with isovalent rare-earth ($A$-site) substitution to effectively apply $c$-axis uniaxial pressure, realizing superconducting bilayer nickelate films with $T_{\mathrm{SDW}}$ suppressed from 150 K to 70 K. Notably, while SDW order is weakened but remains, a second charge-like anisotropy order is completely eliminated in the superconducting state. Polarization-resolved O $K$-edge X-ray absorption and electronic structure calculations show that strengthened interlayer coupling reconstructs the Fermi surface and weakens the SDW. These findings, consistent with a spin-spinless stripe ground state, provide new insight into the mechanism of density wave formation and their interplay with superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 通过氧退火与等价稀土A位替代施加有效c轴单轴压力，将双层镍氧化物薄膜的SDW转变温度从150 K抑制到70 K，并实现超导，揭示层间耦合增强重构费米面、削弱SDW的机制。
AI.motivation: 双层镍氧化物中SDW序与超导的相互作用备受关注。与铜氧化物不同，其T_SDW对氧退火不敏感且在压力下反而升高，因此需要寻找有效调控手段来研究SDW与超导的关系。
AI.method: 结合氧退火与等价稀土(A位)替代，施加有效c轴单轴压力，制备超导双层镍氧化物薄膜；采用偏振分辨O K边X射线吸收谱及电子结构计算分析层间耦合与费米面变化。
AI.result: T_SDW从150 K被抑制至70 K并实现超导；SDW序虽减弱但仍存在，而第二种类电荷各向异性序在超导态被完全消除；偏振XAS和计算表明层间耦合增强重构费米面并削弱SDW。
AI.conclusion: 结果与自旋-无自旋条纹基态一致，为密度波形成机制及其与超导的相互作用提供了新见解。

title: Anyon Proliferation and Anyon Superconductivity in Higgsing Transitions via Conformal Embeddings
comment: 15 pages, including 2 pages of End Matter and 6 pages of Supplemental Material
summary: We discuss (2+1)d Chern-Simons Higgsing transitions based on conformal embeddings and their relation to the proliferation of anyons. These transitions preserve or enlarge the intrinsic topological order despite reducing the gauge group. When the topological order is enlarged, the two phases differ by anyon condensation, and the transition takes an Abelian topological order to a non-Abelian one. In the $SO(N)_{2} \hookrightarrow SU(N)_{1}$ family with $N \geq 3$, the two semiclassical regimes have equivalent intrinsic topological orders but distinct realizations of a global $U(1)$ symmetry. For odd $N$, these are non-Abelian realizations of transitions from fermionic $1/N$ Laughlin states to charge-$2e$ anyon superconductivity coexisting with the same chiral $\mathbb{Z}_{N}$ topological order. The scalar representations are always non-integrable with respect to the UV Chern-Simons level and therefore do not directly label anyons of the un-Higgsed phase, despite defining Wilson lines in the UV. Using heuristic adjoint screening, we propose candidate anyons in the un-Higgsed phase, while branching under the Higgs subgroup reveals channels corresponding to condensable anyons of the Higgs phase. We further construct a $\mathrm{Spin}(16)_{1} \to \mathrm{Spin}(9)_{2}$ transition admitting a condensable algebra that contains a non-Abelian anyon but not all of the allowed gaugable channels in its self-fusion.

AI.tldr: 基于共形嵌入讨论(2+1)维Chern-Simons Higgsing转变及任意子增殖，保持或扩大内禀拓扑序，并构造Spin(16)₁→Spin(9)₂转变。
AI.motivation: 理解规范群缩减时拓扑序如何保持或扩大，以及任意子凝聚与增殖如何驱动Abelian到非Abelian拓扑序的转变，并厘清标量表示与任意子标记的关系。
AI.method: 从共形嵌入出发分析Chern-Simons Higgsing转变；对SO(N)₂↪SU(N)₁家族(N≥3)比较半经典区域；用启发式伴随筛选提出未Higgs相候选任意子，并通过Higgs子群分支识别可凝聚任意子通道；构造Spin(16)₁→Spin(9)₂转变。
AI.result: SO(N)₂↪SU(N)₁两半经典区域拓扑序等价但U(1)全局对称性实现不同；奇数N对应费米子1/N Laughlin态到电荷2e任意子超导的转变，伴随相同手征Z_N拓扑序；标量表示对UV Chern-Simons能级非可积，不能直接标记未Higgs相任意子；Spin(16)₁→Spin(9)₂转变存在包含非Abelian任意子但不含全部可规范通道的可凝聚代数。
AI.conclusion: 共形嵌入为拓扑序保持/扩大的Higgsing转变提供框架，任意子凝聚可导致Abelian到非Abelian转变，且可凝聚代数可含非Abelian任意子。

title: Stacking-Controlled Altermagnetism and Topological Magnons in Bilayer CrI$_3$
summary: Stacked van der Waals magnets provide a tunable route to altermagnetism, a compensated magnetic order characterized by momentum-dependent spin splitting, and to the topological magnetic excitations that such order can host. In bilayer CrI$_3$, first-principles calculations and linear spin-wave theory reveal stacking-controlled altermagnetic order and associated magnon band topology. Combining band-representation analysis with calculations of the dynamic structure factor relevant to inelastic neutron scattering, we further characterize the chirally split topological magnons and quantify their energy corrections and lifetimes using a many-body Green's-function approach. The interlayer magnetic ground state is highly sensitive to the stacking geometry, thereby controlling the magnon band topology and transport responses. We further show that magnon--magnon interactions renormalize the magnon dispersion and dynamic structure factor, with a particular focus on magnon decay. Using van der Waals bilayer CrI$_3$ as a representative platform, our results establish stacking engineering as a structural route for tuning altermagnetism and associated topological magnon excitations, opening avenues toward stacking-controlled spintronic and magnonic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算与线性自旋波理论，研究双层CrI₃中堆叠控制的交变磁序及其拓扑磁振子激发，并利用多体格林函数方法量化磁振子能量修正与寿命。
AI.motivation: 堆叠范德华磁体为交变磁性（动量依赖自旋劈裂的补偿磁序）及拓扑磁激发提供了可调控途径，但堆叠几何如何控制这些序与激发尚待阐明。
AI.method: 第一性原理计算 + 线性自旋波理论；结合能带表示分析与动态结构因子（对应非弹性中子散射）刻画手性劈裂的拓扑磁振子；采用多体格林函数方法计算能量修正与寿命，考察磁振子-磁振子相互作用。
AI.result: 双层CrI₃的层间磁基态对堆叠几何高度敏感，进而控制磁振子能带拓扑与输运响应；磁振子-磁振子相互作用重正化色散关系与动态结构因子，并显著影响磁振子衰减。
AI.conclusion: 以双层CrI₃为代表性平台，确立堆叠工程作为一种调控交变磁性及拓扑磁振子激发的结构手段，为堆叠控制的自旋电子学与磁子学器件开辟途径。

title: Electronic Symmetry and Femtosecond Coherence Dynamics of Renner-Teller-Mixed Neutral Vibronic States in Carbon Dioxide
summary: When non-adiabatic coupling mixes electronic states of a molecule, vibronic states of different electronic symmetry become interleaved across the same spectral region. The symmetry of these states cannot be accessed in conventional spectroscopy due to orientation averaging. We show that molecular-frame angular signatures, which are preserved even when states with different symmetry overlap in energy, can be used to resolve them. Using vacuum-ultraviolet transient absorption spectroscopy of aligned carbon dioxide molecules, we separate two electronically distinct classes of vibronic states ($A^{'}$ and $A^{''}$) that arise from Renner-Teller splitting of the $^1Δ_u$ state. We reconstruct molecular-frame anisotropy continuously across the vibronic manifold showing that the anisotropy crosses over from perpendicular to parallel transition character and maps the interleaved electronic symmetry landscape. By scanning the femtosecond delay between the VUV and a near-infrared pulse through temporal overlap, we measure symmetry-dependent coherence dephasing times of these states and find that the parallel ($A^{'}$) states dephase faster than the perpendicular ($A^{''}$) states. We attribute this to faster departure of the $A^{'}$ wavepacket from the Franck-Condon region due to the distinct topology of the $A^{'}$ excited-state surface. These measurements probe symmetry-resolved ultrafast wavepacket dynamics on the coupled excited-state potential energy surfaces.

AI.tldr: 利用对准CO₂分子的VUV瞬态吸收谱，结合分子框架角度特征，分离并解析了Renner-Teller分裂产生的A'与A''振动电子态的对称性及其超快退相干动力学。
AI.motivation: 非绝热耦合使不同电子对称性的振动电子态在同一光谱区交织，但传统光谱因取向平均无法获取这些态的对称性信息。
AI.method: 对对准的CO₂分子进行真空紫外瞬态吸收谱测量，重建分子框架各向异性，并扫描VUV与近红外脉冲间的飞秒延迟。
AI.result: 成功分离出^1Δ_u态Renner-Teller分裂的两个电子类别（A'和A''）；各向异性从垂直过渡到平行跃迁特征；测得平行A'态退相干快于垂直A''态，归因于A'波包更快离开Franck-Condon区。
AI.conclusion: 该测量实现了耦合激发态势能面上对称性分辨的超快波包动力学探测。

title: An S-matrix Formalism for the Nonclassical Optical Response of Plasmonic Nanowires
comment: 14 pages, 10 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: This paper reports a computational scheme which predicts the light-matter interaction in multiple mesoscopic plasmonic nanowires (NWs), each of which includes concentric or eccentric constituent wires. Lying at the core of the proposed scheme is the S-Matrix of each individual cylindrical interface. The optical response of the materials inside and outside each interface can be described by three popular mesoscopic models: the Hydrodynamic Drude model (HDM) and its diffusive variant, namely the Generalized Nonlocal Optical Response (GNOR) model, as well as the Surface Response Model (SRM). To take into account the relative displacements between the cylindrical interfaces, the addition theorem is applied to construct the main equation behind the algorithm, where the possibility of longitudinal waves intrinsic in the HDM and GNOR models is also included. The optical responses calculated by the proposed S Matrix Method are compared with an in-house developed boundary element method (BEM) toolbox for a single gold NW and an eccentric dual-material NW, and excellent agreements are seen. The algorithm is further physically checked for a sodium nanolens trimer featuring large field focusing, and the effects of the HDM and the SRM are compared.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于S矩阵的计算方法，用于预测多根介观等离激元纳米线（含同心/偏心结构）的光-物质相互作用，并验证其准确性。
AI.motivation: 介观尺度下金属纳米线的等离激元光学响应需考虑非局域效应，现有方法难以高效处理多根、含偏心界面的复杂纳米线体系。
AI.method: 以每个圆柱界面的S矩阵为核心，材料内外光学反应用HDM、GNOR及SRM三种介观模型描述；用加法定理处理界面相对位移，并纳入HDM/GNOR中的纵波，构建算法主方程。
AI.result: 对单根金纳米线和偏心双材料纳米线，与自研边界元法（BEM）工具包结果高度一致；并对具有强场聚焦的钠纳米透镜三聚体进行了物理检验，比较了HDM与SRM效应。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的S矩阵方法能有效且准确地预测多重介观等离激元纳米线的光-物质相互作用。

title: Migration Flows: Population Scaling and Heavy Tails
summary: We show how migration between counties in different cities can explain both the population scaling of mean intercity flows and heavy-tailed intercity net-flow distributions. Density-dependent departure and arrival activities determine how mean flows scale with the populations of the origin and destination cities. We assume Gaussian county-pair net flows with standard deviations proportional to their mean directional flows. At a fixed correlation between county-pair net flows, their sum is Gaussian. Averaging this conditional Gaussian density over the correlation distribution can produce an intermediate power law with a Gaussian cutoff. We also present a stochastic model that generates the variance distribution used in this mixture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出县际迁移机制可同时解释城际平均流量的标度律与重尾净流分布。
AI.motivation: 城际人口流动中，平均城际流量随城市人口呈标度关系，且城际净流量分布呈重尾，现有研究缺乏统一解释这两现象机制。
AI.method: 假设县对净流量为高斯分布，标准差正比于其平均方向流量；密度依赖的出发与到达活动决定平均流量随起点与终点城市人口的标度；对固定相关系数下县对净流量求和得高斯分布，再对相关分布做条件高斯混合，并给出生成该方差分布的随机模型。
AI.result: 对条件高斯密度按相关分布平均后，可产生带高斯截断的中间幂律分布，从而同时再现平均城际流量标度与重尾净流分布。
AI.conclusion: 县际迁移的密度依赖过程与净流相关性分布能够统一解释城际流量的标度及重尾特征，混合模型提供了机制性解释。

title: Effects of on-site Gaussian disorder in the ferromagnetic Blume Capel model
summary: We conduct a numerical study of a generalization of the Blume-Capel model in which the crystal field $D_i$, which controls the local vacancy density, is site dependent rather than uniform. We employ Markov Chain Monte Carlo to compute the shifted phase transition line $T_c$ as a function of the width $σ$ of a gaussian distribution $P(D_i) \sim \exp( -(D_i - \bar{D})^2/2 σ^2)$ at fixed $\bar{D}$. We characterize how the presence of this on-site Gaussian disorder reduces $T_c$ across the second order transition line, and discuss how our results suggest that $T_c$ remains finite even at large values of $σ$. We also determine the effects of disorder on the tricritical point of the conventional, uniform, Blume-Capel model, finding that it significantly suppresses the first-order phase transition, eliminating it entirely at large values of $σ$.

AI.tldr: 本文用MCMC数值研究了位点依赖晶体场（高斯无序）的Blume-Capel模型，考察无序宽度σ对相变线的影响。
AI.motivation: 传统Blume-Capel模型的晶体场是均匀的，而实际系统中局域 vacancy 密度相关的晶体场可能随位点变化，因此需要引入高斯分布的位点无序并研究其对相变行为的影响。
AI.method: 采用Markov Chain Monte Carlo方法，在固定平均晶体场D̄下，计算相变温度Tc随高斯无序宽度σ的变化，并研究无序对三临界点及一级相变的影响。
AI.result: 在二级相变线上，位点高斯无序显著降低Tc，且结果表明即使σ很大时Tc仍保持有限；对均匀Blume-Capel模型的三临界点，无序显著抑制一级相变，并在大σ下完全消除一级相变。
AI.conclusion: 位点依赖的高斯晶体场无序会降低相变温度，但不一定破坏临界性；同时无序能抑制甚至消除一级相变和三临界点。

title: Strongly coupled ultracompressed self-cavity plasmon polaritons at millikelvin temperatures
summary: Van der Waals heterostructures exhibit self-cavity resonances from sub-terahertz to terahertz frequencies and thus offer an attractive route toward realizing cavity-modified phases of matter. Spectroscopy of such systems calls for high frequency resolution at millikelvin temperatures, which is extremely challenging with existing methods. Here we demonstrate a new platform for realizing and probing such systems. Superconducting layers define self-cavity structures with electromagnetic volume compression of order $10^7$. With an integrated graphene layer, we observe underdamped cavity plasmon polaritons at frequencies as low as 0.04 THz and which exhibit avoided crossings with cavity modes. To measure such spectra, we deploy a millikelvin-compatible sub-THz spectrometer based on a superconducting circuit. This work paves the way for simultaneous spectroscopy and transport measurements of cavity-matter hybrid systems at millikelvin temperatures.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一种基于超导层的自腔平台，实现电磁体积压缩约10^7，并结合石墨烯观测到最低0.04 THz的欠阻尼腔等离激元极化激元及其与腔模的避免交叉，配套搭建毫开尔文兼容的亚THz光谱仪。
AI.motivation: 范德华异质结具自腔共振（亚THz至THz），可用于腔改性物态，但其光谱测量需在毫开尔文温度下具备高频率分辨率，现有方法极难满足，因此需要新平台与测量手段。
AI.method: 用超导层定义自腔结构实现电磁体积压缩约10^7；集成石墨烯层；并搭建基于超导电路、兼容毫开尔文的亚THz光谱仪来测量光谱。
AI.result: 观测到频率低至0.04 THz的欠阻尼腔等离激元极化激元，并显示其与腔模之间的避免交叉。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在毫开尔文温度下对腔-物质混合系统进行同步光谱与输运测量开辟了道路。

title: Near-infrared magnetic linear and non-reciprocal directional dichroism in the chiral antiferromagnet SmFe3(BO3)4
summary: We investigated the influence of antiferromagnetic (AFM) order on the near-infrared optical re- sponse of SmFe3(BO3)4 by polarization-resolved, magneto-optical spectroscopy. Below the Néel temperature, we observed pronounced magnetic linear dichroism at the 4f -4f transitions of Sm3+. By rotating the order parameter of the easy-plane AFM ground state using magnetic fields, we demonstrated the magnetic field control of linear dichroism, and deduced polarization selection rules. In addition, we detected non-reciprocal directional dichroism for several 4f -4f transitions. The non-reciprocal absorption appears in the symmetry-allowed toroidal geometry when the in- plane magnetic field is normal to one of the two-fold rotation axes. These results indicate a strong interference between electric- and magnetic-dipole excitations for transitions showing non-reciprocal absorption. The observed optical anisotropies provide a promising path to detect the in-plane orien- tation of the AFM order, enabling imaging and time-resolved studies of the AFM order parameter in rare-earth ferroborates.

AI.tldr: 通过偏振分辨磁光光谱研究反铁磁序对SmFe3(BO3)4近红外光学响应的影响，发现显著的磁线性二色性与非互易方向二色性，并实现磁场调控。
AI.motivation: 探究反铁磁（AFM）序如何影响稀土铁硼酸盐的光学响应，并寻找探测AFM序参量取向的光学手段，以支持成像与时间分辨研究。
AI.method: 采用偏振分辨的磁光光谱技术，在低于奈尔温度条件下研究SmFe3(BO3)4中Sm3+的4f-4f跃迁；通过磁场旋转易平面AFM基态的序参量，推导偏振选择定则。
AI.result: 在Sm3+的4f-4f跃迁处观察到明显磁线性二色性；实现磁场对线性二色性的调控；在对称允许的环向几何（面内磁场垂直于二重旋转轴）中检测到非互易方向二色性，表明电偶极与磁偶极激发之间存在强干涉。
AI.conclusion: 观测到的光学各向异性为检测AFM序的面内取向提供了有效途径，可用于稀土铁硼酸盐中AFM序参量的成像与时间分辨研究。

title: Orbital angular momentum in crystalline solids: non-equilibrium theory
summary: We develop a general operator theory of orbital angular momentum (OAM) in periodic solids that applies equally to equilibrium and coherently driven states. Employing the crystal momentum representation of Adams and Blount, we construct a periodic-solid OAM operator exactly corresponding to the symmetrized $\hat{\mathbf r}\times\hat{\mathbf v}$ observable, and show that it separates into local circulation (LC) and itinerant circulation (IC) sectors that are Hermitian and $U(1)$, and more generally $U(N)$, gauge covariant. In equilibrium, the LC and IC sectors reduce to the established modern theory of orbital magnetism; out of equilibrium, the same operator structure exposes new contributions generated by laser-written momentum-space textures and interband coherence. Applied to gapped graphene, we uncover a rich phenomenology of ultrafast non-equilibrium orbital angular momentum, including a quasi-stationary light-induced OAM. This latter finding, underpinned by a close connection between band-manifold phase texture and nonequilibrium OAM, points towards new possibilities for light control over OAM in solids as well as a potentially rich role for topological band structures in designed OAM materials.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了周期性固体中轨道角动量(OAM)的通用算符理论，统一描述平衡态与相干驱动态，并应用于带隙石墨烯揭示超快非平衡OAM现象。
AI.motivation: 现有OAM理论多针对平衡态，缺乏能统一描述平衡与非平衡（如激光驱动）固态OAM的框架；需要构造与对称化可观测量严格对应的算符以研究光控OAM。
AI.method: 采用Adams-Blount晶体动量表象，构造对应对称化 r×v 的周期固体OAM算符，并证明其可分解为局域环流(LC)与巡游环流(IC)两个厄米、U(1)及U(N)规范协变的部分；随后应用于带隙石墨烯分析非平衡OAM。
AI.result: 平衡态下LC与IC归结为现代轨道磁性理论；非平衡态下揭示激光写入的动量空间纹理与带间相干产生的新贡献。在带隙石墨烯中发现丰富的超快非平衡OAM，包括准稳态光致OAM。
AI.conclusion: 能带流形相位纹理与非平衡OAM密切相关，为固态OAM的光控及拓扑能带结构在OAM材料设计中的应用开辟新可能。

title: Toward Long-Range Correlation Energies from Charge Fluctuations: Incorporating Exact Exchange into ACKS2$ω$
summary: Long-range electronic correlation can be represented in terms of coupled fluctuations of atomic charges and higher multipoles, motivating a density-response description beyond local dipolar polarization, particularly in low-dimensional, conducting, and small-gap systems where collective electronic fluctuations become important. We extend the frequency-dependent polarizable force field ACKS2$ω$ to electronic-structure references containing exact exchange by deriving both the static and additional frequency-dependent exchange contributions, with particular attention to HFsrPBE, which combines long-range Hartree--Fock exchange with short-range PBE exchange and correlation. Numerical validation of ACKS2$ω$ using dipole polarizabilities and $C_6$ dispersion coefficients for the 27 molecules of the TS27 set, with HF, PBE, B3LYP, and HFsrPBE as the underlying electronic-structure references, shows that including the exchange contributions and enriching the response basis improve agreement with the corresponding orbital-space linear-response calculations, although finite-response-basis errors remain molecule dependent. Long-range correlation energies evaluated through the adiabatic-connection fluctuation-dissipation theorem using the ACKS2$ω$ parameters reproduce the corresponding HFsrPBE orbital-space results for small test molecules when the response basis is made complete within the chosen orbital basis, while a local multipole decomposition resolves the finite-basis energies into monopole--monopole, mixed, dipole--dipole, and remaining higher-multipole contributions, providing a route to evaluating long-range correlation energies in terms of charge fluctuations within atom-condensed models.

AI.tldr: 本文将频率依赖极化力场ACKS2ω扩展到含精确交换的电子结构参考（尤其HFsrPBE），推导静态与频率依赖交换贡献，并通过偶极极化率、C6系数及长程关联能验证其与轨道空间线性响应计算的一致性。
AI.motivation: 长程电子关联可表示为原子电荷与高阶多极矩的耦合涨落，需要超越局域偶极极化的密度响应描述，在低维、导电及小带隙体系中尤为重要。
AI.method: 将ACKS2ω频率依赖极化力场扩展至含精确交换的参考，推导静态及额外频率依赖交换贡献，重点关注混合长程HF与短程PBE交换关联的HFsrPBE；用TS27集分子的偶极极化率和C6色散系数进行数值验证，并基于绝热连接涨落耗散定理计算长程关联能，用局域多极展开分解能量。
AI.result: 以HF、PBE、B3LYP、HFsrPBE为参考时，纳入交换贡献并丰富响应基可改善与轨道空间线性响应计算的一致性，但有限响应基误差依分子而异；响应基在所选轨道基内完备时，ACKS2ω参数重现小分子HFsrPBE轨道空间长程关联能，并能将有限基能量分解为单极-单极、混合、偶极-偶极及剩余高阶多极贡献。
AI.conclusion: 该扩展为在原子凝聚模型框架内以电荷涨落评估长程关联能提供了途径。

title: RFBniCS: An open-source simulation framework for redox flow batteries
summary: We present RFBniCS, an open-source finite-element framework implemented in FEniCSx for simulating redox-flow-battery (RFB) half-cells. RFBniCS solves an established macro-homogeneous porous-electrode model accounting for strongly coupled electrolyte flow, multicomponent species transport, ionic and electronic charge conservation, and interfacial Faradaic charge transfer. Different from other open-access tools, RFBniCS can perform transient RFB half-cell simulations in one-, two-, and three-dimensional geometries while explicitly resolving the transport of both redox-active and supporting-electrolyte species. It also describes electrolyte flow through porous electrodes and, in the three-dimensional formulation, through adjacent flow channels. To verify the implementation, RFBniCS's predictions in parameter-limiting regimes are compared against other published implementations, with RFBniCS generally showing superior accuracy and speed. We further demonstrate RFBniCS's capabilities by a simulation of the transient response of the negative half-cell of a vanadium redox flow battery, with a moderately concentrated supporting electrolyte. In the current implementation, RFBniCS provides the computational basis for studying redox-flow-battery half-cells and can be extended to complex flow-field designs, alternative chemistries, full-cell coupling, detailed membrane transport, and additional multiphysics effects.

AI.tldr: RFBniCS是一个基于FEniCSx的开源有限元框架，用于模拟氧化还原液流电池半电池，可进行1D/2D/3D瞬态仿真，精度与速度优于现有工具。
AI.motivation: 现有开源工具难以同时显式解析氧化还原活性物种与支持电解质物种的传输，且缺乏对多维度瞬态RFB半电池的完整模拟能力，因此需要一个更通用、准确的仿真框架。
AI.method: 在FEniCSx中实现RFBniCS，求解宏观均质多孔电极模型，耦合电解液流动、多组分物种传输、离子与电子电荷守恒以及界面Faradaic电荷转移；支持1D/2D/3D，并在3D中解析相邻流道。
AI.result: 通过与已发表实现的参数限制工况对比验证，RFBniCS普遍表现出更优的精度与速度；并成功模拟了中等浓度支持电解质下钒液流电池负极半电池的瞬态响应。
AI.conclusion: RFBniCS为RFB半电池研究提供了计算基础，未来可扩展至复杂流场设计、替代化学体系、全电池耦合、膜传输细节及其他多物理效应。

title: Dynamical Critical Properties of the Random-Bond three-state Potts Model
summary: We study the dynamic critical behavior of the two-dimensional random-bond three-state Potts model using large-scale Monte Carlo simulations with the Wolff and Swendsen--Wang cluster algorithms. At the disorder-dependent critical temperature, we compute integrated and exponential autocorrelation times and extract the dynamic critical exponent $z$ via finite-size scaling. Critical slowing down is significantly weakened by bond randomness, with the dynamic exponent decreasing from $z \approx 0.54$ in the pure system to $z \approx 0.24$ at strong disorder. From the finite-size scaling of the Wolff cluster size, we obtain $γ/ν\approx 1.73$, where $γ$ and $ν$ are the susceptibility and correlation-length exponents, respectively, consistent with the universality class of the two-dimensional three-state Potts model. These results indicate that bond randomness strongly affects the critical dynamics but leaves the underlying static universality class unchanged. Furthermore, both static and dynamic observables, including the specific heat and the autocorrelation times, show a lack of self-averaging.

AI.tldr: 本文用大规模蒙特卡洛模拟研究二维随机键三态Potts模型的动态临界行为，发现键无序显著削弱临界慢化（z从约0.54降至约0.24），但不改变静态普适类，且静态与动态观测量均缺乏自平均性。
AI.motivation: 探究键无序（quenched disorder）如何影响二维三态Potts模型的临界动力学，特别是临界慢化（critical slowing down）与动态临界指数z的变化，以及无序是否改变静态普适类。
AI.method: 采用Wolff和Swendsen–Wang集团算法进行大规模蒙特卡洛模拟；在随无序变化的临界温度下计算积分与指数自相关时间，通过有限尺寸标度提取动态临界指数z；并利用Wolff集团尺寸的有限尺寸标度获得γ/ν。
AI.result: 键无序显著削弱临界慢化：动态指数z从纯系统的约0.54降至强无序时的约0.24。由Wolff集团尺寸标度得到γ/ν≈1.73，与二维三态Potts模型的普适类一致。比热和自相关时间等静态与动态观测量均表现出缺乏自平均性。
AI.conclusion: 键无序强烈影响临界动力学（削弱临界慢化），但未改变底层静态普适类；同时系统在静态和动态观测量上都缺乏自平均性。

title: Algebraic Relaxation of Strong-to-Weak Symmetry-Breaking Order via Charge-Sector Broadening
summary: Strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SW-SSB) is a distinctive phenomenon of mixed quantum states, characterized by nonlinear long-range order associated with strong symmetry. In realistic open quantum systems, however, strong symmetry is macroscopically fragile and can be explicitly reduced to weak symmetry through local charge exchange with the environment. In this paper, we investigate how the SW-SSB order decays under such strong-symmetry-breaking Liouvillian dynamics. For discrete $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry, a local symmetry-breaking perturbation drives an exponential decay of the Rényi-1 long-range correlator, revealing the fragility of discrete SW-SSB order. By contrast, for continuous $U(1)$ symmetry, local charge exchange broadens the distribution over symmetry-charge sectors and leads to parametrically slower algebraic relaxation. We establish a rigorous algebraic lower bound on the connected Rényi-1 long-range correlation, demonstrating the robustness of this slow relaxation. In the thermodynamic limit, we further uncover a two-stage dynamical scaling: $\tilde{R}_1\sim t^{-1}$ at early times and $\tilde{R}_1\sim t^{-1/z}$ at long times, with $z$ set by the underlying hydrodynamic dynamics. As a numerical verification, we consider fermionic chains with $z=2$ and $z=4$, which are excellent agreement with the theoretical predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究强到弱自发对称破缺(SW-SSB)序在破坏强对称性的Lindblad动力学下的衰减，发现离散Z2对称呈指数衰减而连续U(1)对称呈代数慢弛豫，并揭示两阶段动力学标度。
AI.motivation: SW-SSB是混合量子态中与强对称相关的非线性长程序，但在实际开放系统中强对称宏观上脆弱，可能被环境的局域电荷交换显式降为弱对称，因此需要理解这种破坏如何使SW-SSB序衰减。
AI.method: 采用Liouvillian动力学，分别考察离散Z2与连续U(1)对称下局域对称破缺扰动的影响；对U(1)情形建立关于连通Rényi-1长程关联的严格代数下界，并用费米子链(z=2和z=4)进行数值验证。
AI.result: Z2对称下Rényi-1长程关联呈指数衰减，显示离散SW-SSB序的脆弱性；U(1)对称下电荷交换展宽对称电荷扇区分布，导致参数上更慢的代数弛豫，并在热力学极限下出现两阶段标度：早期ẼR1~t^{-1}，晚期ẼR1~t^{-1/z}，z由流体动力学决定。费米子链数值结果与理论预测高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 破坏强对称的局域扰动使离散SW-SSB序指数式消失，而连续对称的SW-SSB序因电荷扇区展宽而受代数下界保护呈慢弛豫，其动力学标度由底层流体动力学决定，可通过费米子链数值验证。

title: Mechanism of Incommensurate Magnetic Order in $\mathrm{BaCo_2(AsO_4)_2}$: Interplay of Frustrated Further-Neighbor Exchanges and Bond-Directional Anisotropy
summary: The microscopic mechanism governing the zero-field incommensurate magnetic order in the honeycomb cobaltate $\mathrm{BaCo}_2(\mathrm{AsO}_4)_2$ remains a significant unresolved problem, particularly concerning the relative contributions of bond-directional Kitaev-type interactions and exchange frustration. This study investigates an extended $J_1\text{--}K\text{--}Γ\text{--}Γ'\text{--}J_2\text{--}J_3$ model, which incorporates XXZ-type exchange anisotropies on the honeycomb lattice. Nearest-neighbor parameters are constrained by ab initio electronic structure calculations. By integrating the analytical Luttinger-Tisza approach with exact diagonalization calculations under twisted boundary conditions, we delineate the classical and quantum phase diagrams across the $(J_2, J_3)$ parameter space. We demonstrate that the stabilization of the experimentally observed incommensurate spiral phase, propagating along the $Γ\to M$ direction, does not necessitate an anomalously dominant Kitaev coupling. Instead, this phase arises naturally from the synergistic interplay between exchange frustration, driven by further-neighbor couplings ($J_2, J_3$), and intermediate off-diagonal bond anisotropies ($Γ, Γ'$). In the quantum regime, we elucidate the competition between this incommensurate manifold and an out-of-plane ferromagnetic ($\mathrm{FM}_z$) phase, which is selectively stabilized via a quantum order-by-disorder mechanism. Our findings reconcile conflicting interpretations of the magnetic interactions in $\mathrm{BaCo}_2(\mathrm{AsO}_4)_2$ and establish the microscopic origin and stability range of its incommensurate ground state.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过扩展的 J1-K-Γ-Γ'-J2-J3 模型（含 XXZ 各向异性）结合 ab initio、Luttinger-Tisza 与扭转边界精确对角化，阐明 BaCo2(AsO4)2 的零场非共线磁序源自交换阻挫与键各向异性的协同作用，而非异常强的 Kitaev 耦合。
AI.motivation: BaCo2(AsO4)2 中零场非共线磁序的微观机制尚不清楚，尤其是键方向 Kitaev 相互作用与交换阻挫的相对贡献存在争议。
AI.method: 构建含 XXZ 各向异性的 J1-K-Γ-Γ'-J2-J3 模型；用 ab initio 约束近邻参数；结合解析 Luttinger-Tisza 方法与扭转边界条件下的精确对角化，绘制 (J2, J3) 参数空间的经典与量子相图。
AI.result: 沿 Γ→M 方向传播的非共线螺旋相无需异常主导的 Kitaev 耦合，而是由 J2、J3 驱动的交换阻挫与中等 Γ、Γ' 键各向异性协同产生；量子区域中该相与面外铁磁 FMz 相竞争，后者通过量子无序选择机制稳定。
AI.conclusion: 研究调和了关于 BaCo2(AsO4)2 磁相互作用的冲突解释，确立了其非共线基态的微观起源与稳定范围。

title: Reference-free certification of machine-learning interatomic potentials
summary: Universal machine-learning interatomic potentials now reach held-out energy and force errors so small that they no longer predict how a model behaves in simulation. Here we show that a potential can be graded without any reference calculation, against properties the exact Born-Oppenheimer surface satisfies by mathematical or physical necessity. We organise these properties into four families, symmetry and invariance, self-consistency and integrability, statistical-mechanical equilibrium and regularity, and turn them into fourteen inexpensive probes, each certifying against a target that is exact and independent of chemistry and reference method. Every probe therefore returns an absolute, architecture-comparable score from the energies, forces and stresses a potential already exposes, and reveals failures a fixed test set cannot. Applied to 64 pretrained potentials, the suite resolves two orders of magnitude of certified quality at comparable reported accuracy, and flags a fine-tuned potential whose reference errors improve while its surface degrades until molecular dynamics fails. An interactive leaderboard of all 64 models is available at https://jhaens.github.io/pescert-bench.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需参考计算的势函数评测方法：基于Born-Oppenheimer面必然满足的物理/数学性质，构建14个探针，从能量/力/应力给出绝对、可跨架构比较的分数，区分两个数量级的质量差异并揭示固定测试集测不出的失效。
AI.motivation: 通用机器学习原子间势的能量与力误差已小到无法体现模拟中的真实行为，而传统依赖参考计算的评测无法反映这一点，需要一种不依赖化学与参考方法的评测手段。
AI.method: 将精确Born-Oppenheimer面必然满足的性质分为四类——对称性与不变性、自洽性与可积性、统计力学平衡与正则性——转化为14个廉价探针，每个探针针对精确且与化学/参考方法无关的目标，从势函数已提供的能量、力、应力中计算评分。
AI.result: 应用于64个预训练势，在报告精度相近的情况下区分出两个数量级的认证质量；并识别出一个微调势——其参考误差改善但势面退化直至分子动力学失败。
AI.conclusion: 无需参考计算的绝对评分可以比固定测试集更可靠地衡量势函数的模拟可用性；64个模型的交互式排行榜见 https://jhaens.github.io/pescert-bench 。

title: SupraTITO: Transferable Generative Molecular Dynamics for Supramolecular Systems
summary: Peptide sequence governs both the structures formed through supramolecular assembly and the dynamics by which they emerge, but predicting either requires resolving slow collective processes among many interacting molecules. Molecular dynamics (MD) provides microscopic insight into these processes, yet the long timescales of assembly and the vast peptide sequence space make systematic exploration computationally demanding. We introduce SupraTITO, a transferable generative molecular dynamics (GenMD) framework for supramolecular systems, demonstrated through peptide self-assembly. SupraTITO learns transferable implicit transfer operators (TITO) conditioned on peptide sequence, molecular topology, and periodic geometry, allowing configurations to be propagated over physical intervals much longer than an MD integration step. On a comprehensive dipeptide benchmark, SupraTITO generalizes to held-out sequences and reproduces sequence-dependent structures and dynamics while maintaining molecular integrity over long rollouts. Compared with direct ensemble prediction trained on the same trajectory data, SupraTITO more accurately reproduces assembly structures while also resolving their temporal evolution. The learned dynamics generalize across peptide concentrations, including dilute conditions not represented during training. These results extend transferable GenMD to collective dynamics in periodic supramolecular systems and provide a foundation for modeling related processes beyond peptide assembly.

AI.tldr: 提出 SupraTITO，一种可迁移的生成式分子动力学(GenMD)框架，通过二肽自组装学习序列条件下的隐式迁移算子，实现远超积分步长的长时程推演，能泛化到未见序列与不同浓度。
AI.motivation: 肽序列同时决定超分子组装的结构与动力学，但预测这一点需解析多分子相互作用的慢速集体过程。MD 虽提供微观视角，却因组装时标长、序列空间巨大而计算代价高昂，难以系统探索。
AI.method: 提出 SupraTITO 框架，学习以肽序列、分子拓扑和周期性几何为条件的可迁移隐式迁移算子(TITO)，使构型能按远长于 MD 积分步的物理时间间隔进行传播；并在二肽基准上以相同轨迹数据训练进行对比。
AI.result: 在综合二肽基准上，SupraTITO 泛化到留出序列，复现序列依赖的结构与动力学，并在长时推演中保持分子完整性；相比直接系综预测，更准确复现组装结构并解析其时间演化；学到的动力学可跨浓度泛化，包括训练中未出现的稀溶液条件。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将可迁移 GenMD 扩展到周期性超分子体系的集体动力学，为肽组装之外的相关过程建模奠定基础。

title: Work fluctuation speed limit in boundary conformal field theories
summary: We explore the fundamental limits on finite-time driving in quantum critical systems described by boundary conformal field theory. We show that stochastic work fluctuations arising from external driving are a resource for speedy control, and derive an exact, saturable fluctuation-based speed limit in weakly driven boundary conformal field theories at finite temperature. The bound and saturating protocol can be expressed entirely in terms of the universal scaling dimension, and the result interpolates between the Kibble--Zurek regime,where temporal correlations are strongly nonlocal, and an adiabatic regime where linear driving becomes optimal. For small scaling dimension, the enhanced temporal correlations produce pronounced departures from linear protocols and a larger optimization advantage. These results establish a universal work precision--time tradeoff for boundary-critical control, applicable to quantum impurity, fractional quantum Hall, and superconducting-circuit platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究边界共形场论描述的量子临界系统中有限时间驱动的根本极限，推导出基于涨落的可饱和速度极限，并揭示其仅由普适标度维度决定的精度-时间权衡。
AI.motivation: 探索量子临界系统中快速驱动的根本限制，并揭示随机功涨落作为加速控制资源的潜力。
AI.method: 针对有限温度下弱驱动的边界共形场论，推导精确、可饱和的基于涨落的速度极限，并构造饱和协议，用普适标度维度表达结果。
AI.result: 该界限在Kibble-Zurek区域（时间关联强非局域）与绝热区域（线性驱动最优）之间插值；小标度维度下时间关联增强，导致明显偏离线性协议且优化优势更大。
AI.conclusion: 建立了边界临界控制的普适功精度-时间权衡，适用于量子杂质、分数量子霍尔和超导电路平台。

title: How Superradiance Survives Molecular Noise inside Virus Capsids
summary: Excited organic dyes chemically bound to an icosahedral virus shell can spontaneously synchronize and emit a superradiant burst of light. The mechanism that allows it to occur at room temperature, despite collisional dephasing and inhomogeneous broadening, is not understood. Few other known low-dimensional condensed matter systems exhibit room-temperature superradiance (SR). In the fluctuation-prone environment of molecular-based systems, electron--vibrational coupling has been proposed to play a central role. Here, we addressed experimentally the existence of underdamped virus capsid phonon-like modes and theoretically their involvement in the transition from uncorrelated to cooperative emission. We find that SR-active dye-labeled capsids exhibit underdamped low-frequency oscillations that modulate the dye excited-state response, and modeling shows how such capsid motion can promote the collective polarization required for superradiant emission.

AI.tldr: 本文结合实验与理论，研究二十面体病毒衣壳上有机染料分子如何在室温下实现超辐射发光，发现病毒衣壳存在欠阻尼低频振荡，可调制染料激发态响应并促进集体极化。
AI.motivation: 有机染料与病毒衣壳结合后可在室温下自发同步并发出超辐射光爆，但室温下碰撞退相干和非均匀展宽通常应阻碍该现象，其机制尚不清楚。低维凝聚态系统中室温超辐射案例稀少，因此需要解释这一机制。
AI.method: 实验上探究病毒衣壳是否存在欠阻尼类声子模式；理论上建模分析这些模式在从非相关发射向协同发射转变中的作用，并将衣壳运动与染料激发态响应及集体极化联系起来。
AI.result: 发现具有超辐射活性的染料标记衣壳表现出欠阻尼低频振荡，这些振荡会调制染料的激发态响应。
AI.conclusion: 建模表明衣壳运动能够促进超辐射发射所需的集体极化，从而为室温下分子系统中超辐射的实现机制提供了实验与理论支持。

title: The half-filled optical Su-Schrieffer-Heeger-Hubbard model with uniaxial strain
summary: Strain offers a direct route to control electronic phases by altering bond lengths, hopping amplitudes, and lattice symmetries. These aspects make electron-phonon (e-ph) coupled systems a natural setting to study strain-induced effects. The Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) Hamiltonian describes the coupling between itinerant electrons and lattice degrees of freedom that modulate hopping and is thus expected to be strongly affected by strain fields. At half-filling and on a bipartite lattice, the SSH interactions drive dominant bond-order-wave (BOW) correlations at low- temperature in which short bonds with high kinetic energy alternate with long bonds with low kinetic energy along four possible patterns. We model uniaxial strain through anisotropic hopping, which breaks the $90^\circ$ rotational symmetry and reduces the BOW phase degeneracy to two. We also include an on-site Hubbard U that promotes antiferromagnetic correlations that are also (weakly) driven by the SSH interaction itself. We map out the half-filled phase diagram in the plane of the e-ph and Hubbard couplings, and determine the critical temperature of BOW formation. Using analytic continuation, we also evaluate the spectral function and demonstrate directionally dependent gap formation in the BOW phase

AI.tldr: 本文利用量子蒙特卡洛等方法，研究在单轴应变（各向异性跃迁）和Hubbard U共同作用下，半填充Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) 模型的相图，重点分析键序波(BOW)与反铁磁关联的竞争及BOW转变温度。
AI.motivation: 应变可通过改变键长、跃迁振幅和晶格对称性直接调控电子相，而SSH模型正是描述电子与调制跃迁的晶格自由度耦合的典范，因此应变对e-ph耦合系统的影响值得系统研究，尤其在半填充双分晶格上BOW相的主导地位及应变如何解除其简并尚需厘清。
AI.method: 将单轴应变建模为各向异性跃迁，破坏90°旋转对称，使BOW相简并度从四种降为两种；同时引入在位Hubbard U以纳入反铁磁关联（SSH相互作用本身也弱驱动AF）。在半填充下扫描e-ph耦合与Hubbard耦合构成的相图，确定BOW形成的临界温度，并通过解析延拓计算谱函数。
AI.result: 给出了半填充下e-ph与Hubbard耦合平面的相图，确定了BOW形成的临界温度；解析延拓得到的谱函数显示BOW相中带隙形成具有方向依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 单轴应变通过各向异性跃迁降低BOW相简并并产生方向依赖的能隙，BOW与反铁磁关联在相图中竞争，明确了应变与Hubbard相互作用对SSH系统电子相的协同调控作用。

title: Long-Range Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials for Defect Energetics in SrTiO$_3$
summary: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have advanced rapidly in recent years, yet the majority of models remain semilocal in nature and neglect long-range electrostatic interactions. A growing number of long-range models have emerged to address this limitation, but systematic benchmarks comparing their performance on physically realistic systems remain scarce. In this work, we assess three long-range MLIPs -- MACE-POLAR, MACE-LES, and LOREM, against a short-range baseline MACE model, on their ability to capture long-range Coulombic interactions, progressing from idealised synthetic point-charge systems to first-principles data on realistic crystal structures. This progression allows us to isolate model's capability to learn electrostatic interactions from the many competing energy contributions, such as dielectric screening and exchange-correlation, that are present in DFT total energies. As a physically motivated benchmark system, we focus on strontium titanate SrTiO$_3$ with Sr--O Schottky vacancy pairs, a material in which long-range charge interactions play a central role and which serves as a natural stepping stone towards the study of charged polarons and other electronic and optical properties. Building on this benchmark, we further examine oxygen vacancy migration in the presence of the Sr--O Schottky pair, using climbing-image nudged elastic band calculations and molecular dynamics to obtain activation barriers as a function of the vacancy pair separation, providing further extrapolation test of each model's ability to capture the electrostatic effects that govern defect transport.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评测三种长程机器学习势（MACE-POLAR、MACE-LES、LOREM）相较于短程MACE基线，在捕捉长程库仑相互作用方面的能力，从理想点电荷体系逐步过渡到真实晶体SrTiO3缺陷体系。
AI.motivation: 多数机器学习原子间势是半局域的，忽略长程静电相互作用；虽有长程模型涌现，但缺乏在物理真实体系上的系统基准比较。
AI.method: 以短程MACE为基线，对比MACE-POLAR、MACE-LES、LOREM三种长程模型；从合成点电荷体系到第一性原理真实晶体数据递进评测，聚焦SrTiO3的Sr-O肖特基空位对；采用CI-NEB与分子动力学计算氧空位迁移激活能随空位对间距的变化。
AI.result: 通过从理想体系到真实缺陷体系的递进评测，可分离模型学习静电相互作用的能力与介电屏蔽、交换关联等竞争能量贡献的影响；获得激活势垒随空位对间距变化的规律，用于外推测试各模型捕捉影响缺陷输运的静电效应。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为评估长程MLIP在真实物理体系中的静电建模能力提供了系统框架，并为研究带电极化子等电子与光学性质奠定基础。

title: Deciphering the internal conversion and triplet formation in thymine via time-resolved multi-center X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy
summary: The photostability of DNA nucleobases relies on ultrafast nonradiative relaxation following ultraviolet excitation. In thymine, the competition between internal conversion (IC) and intersystem crossing (ISC) determines the balance between ultrafast energy dissipation and potentially long-lived photochemistry. However, the precise molecular mechanisms linking early singlet-state electronic and structural evolution to the formation of long-lived triplet dark states remain unresolved. Here, we investigate the gas-phase photodynamics of thymine using time-resolved multi-center X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (tr-mc-XPS) supported by state-of-the-art ab initio quantum calculations. By simultaneously probing multiple carbon 1s core levels, we track site-specific electronic and nuclear dynamics. We discover that the long-lived dark state is not initially a pure triplet; rather, it exists as a mixture of singlet and triplet states for the first 240 ps before transitioning fully to the $^3ππ^*$ state. On the femtosecond timescale, we resolve atom-specific vibrational coherence at $\sim$730 cm$^{-1}$ (a ring-breathing mode with a period of 46 fs) that survives the initial $^1ππ^*$ to $^1nπ^*$ IC. Furthermore, we identify a critical dual role for the methyl group (C9H$_3$). During singlet relaxation, the methyl group acts as an inertia spectator, and its mass hinders direct internal conversion to the ground state. Upon $^3ππ^*$ state formation, however, state-dependent hyperconjugation couples the methyl group to the pyrimidine ring, turning it into a highly sensitive electronic reporter of ISC. These findings establish tr-mc-XPS as a powerful approach for disentangling the complex, multi-timescale photodynamics governing nucleobase stability.

AI.tldr: 本文利用时间分辨多中心X射线光电子谱(tr-mc-XPS)结合从头算量子计算，揭示胸腺嘧啶气相光动力学：长寿命暗态前240 ps为单-三重态混合，随后转为纯³ππ*态，并阐明甲基在单重态弛豫与ISC中的双重作用。
AI.motivation: DNA核碱基的光稳定性依赖紫外激发后的超快非辐射弛豫。胸腺嘧啶中内转换(IC)与系间窜越(ISC)的竞争决定能量耗散与长寿命光化学的平衡，但早期单重态电子与结构演化如何联系长寿命三重暗态的形成机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用时间分辨多中心X射线光电子谱(tr-mc-XPS)研究气相胸腺嘧啶光动力学，通过同时探测多个碳1s芯能级追踪位点特异的电子与核动力学，并辅以先进从头算量子计算。
AI.result: 发现长寿命暗态最初并非纯三重态，而是单重态与三重态混合，持续240 ps后才完全转变为³ππ*态；在飞秒尺度分辨出约730 cm⁻¹（环呼吸模式，周期46 fs）的原子特异振动相干，且能经受¹ππ*到¹nπ*的IC过程；甲基(C9H₃)具双重作用——单重态弛豫时作为惯性旁观者，其质量阻碍直接内转换至基态，而³ππ*态形成后经态依赖超共轭将甲基耦合到嘧啶环，使其成为ISC的高灵敏电子报告基团。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了tr-mc-XPS是解析核碱基稳定性背后复杂多时间尺度光动力学的有力手段。

title: On thermalization in random free fermions: Statistical origins and energy-dependent ETH structure
summary: We study the thermalization in the random free fermion model by a detailed random-matrix analysis. By computing the ensemble average and fluctuations of $\operatorname{Tr}(Aρ(t))$ for a single-particle observable $A$, we derive the thermalization function $g^2(t/τ_λ)$ with $τ_λ= \hbar/(2η\sqrt{N})$, prove its $|t|^{-3}$ asymptotic decay, and show that the variance of the fluctuations vanishes as $O(1/N)$ in the thermodynamic limit.Particle number conservation is also incorporated into the model, by which we further study the energy-shell eigenstate statistics and prove a factorization theorem of the eigenstate statistics. We further show that under a controlled eigenvector-eigenvalue correlation deformation, the diagonal energy-resolved slope and the off-diagonal eigenstate thermalization hypothesis spectral function acquire an energy dependence.Finally, we compute the fluctuations of correlation functions and compare the fluctuation scales with those of a fully chaotic system, revealing quantitative differences rooted in the Gaussian nature of the eigenstates.Our work establishes the random free fermion model as an analytically solvable realization of weak eigenstate thermalization hypothesis type self-averaging, and as a controllable setting in which eigenbasis chaos can be separated from spectral chaos.

AI.tldr: 本文通过随机矩阵分析研究随机自由费米子模型的热化，证明热化函数以 |t|^{-3} 衰减、涨落方差为 O(1/N)，并建立本征态统计的因子化定理。
AI.motivation: 理解自由费米子模型（可积/非混沌）中热化与涨落行为，区分本征基混沌与谱混沌，为弱本征态热化假说（ETH）和自平均提供可解析求解的范例。
AI.method: 对单粒子可观测量 A 计算 Tr(Aρ(t)) 的系综平均与涨落；引入粒子数守恒，研究能量壳本征态统计并证明因子化定理；施加受控的本征矢-本征值关联形变；计算关联函数涨落并与全混沌系统对比。
AI.result: 推导出热化函数 g²(t/τ_λ)，时间尺度 τ_λ=ħ/(2η√N)，证明其 |t|^{-3} 渐近衰减；证明涨落方差随 N 趋于热力学极限时以 O(1/N) 消失；证明本征态统计因子化定理；在关联形变下对角能量分辨斜率与离对角 ETH 谱函数出现能量依赖；关联函数涨落与全混沌系统定量不同，源于本征态的高斯性。
AI.conclusion: 随机自由费米子模型是弱 ETH 型自平均的解析可解实现，也是可分离本征基混沌与谱混沌的可控平台。

title: Tunable Electron Quantum Optics in Graphene Slit Junctions
summary: A graphene slit junction is investigated as a compact geometry for directional electron-beam formation, coherent interference, and symmetry-controlled spin filtering. Atomistic tight-binding calculations combined with the nonequilibrium Green's function formalism show that trigonal warping in monolayer graphene produces strongly directional electron beams near E~2.7eV. Boundary reflections redirect these beams toward a common drain, where the transmission exhibits magnetic flux-dependent oscillations consistent with an h/e Aharonov-Bohm period, whose modulation is characterized by Fourier analysis and harmonic fitting. A local electrostatic gate provides additional control of the interference phase. In separate self-consistent mean-field Hubbard calculations, the pristine antiferromagnetic ground state is shown to have spin-degenerate transmission, whereas structural or electrostatic breaking of the left-right symmetry enables spin filtering. Complementary valley-resolved calculations using a four-band continuum model demonstrate analogous beam formation in bilayer graphene at E = 50meV. The results identify the slit junction as a common geometry for electron-optical and spin-dependent transport and motivate further investigation of low-energy bilayer implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究石墨烯狭缝结作为紧凑几何结构，用于定向电子束形成、相干干涉和对称性调控的自旋过滤，结合紧束缚与NEGF计算，并扩展到双层石墨烯。
AI.motivation: 寻找一种紧凑几何结构，同时实现定向电子束、相干干涉和自旋过滤等多功能电子光学与自旋输运行为。
AI.method: 原子级紧束缚结合非平衡格林函数(NEGF)；自洽平均场Hubbard计算；四带连续模型谷分辨计算。
AI.result: 单层石墨烯中三角翘曲在E~2.7eV处产生强定向电子束，边界反射导向公共漏极，透射呈现h/e Aharonov-Bohm周期振荡；局域栅极调控干涉相位。反铁磁基态透射自旋简并，左右对称破缺实现自旋过滤；双层石墨烯在E=50meV显示类似束形成。
AI.conclusion: 狭缝结可作为电子光学与自旋相关输运的通用几何结构，并值得进一步研究低能双层实现。

title: Local geometry of the Fermi surface and its effect on the electronic characteristics of normal metals
summary: Fine features in the Fermi surface geometry, such as nearly cylindrical or nearly paraboloidal strips or local flattenings, are examined as regards their effect on the electronic, mainly galvanomagnetic, properties of metals. It is shown that under certain conditions, these features may significantly change the way a conventional normal metal or a layered structure with metallic conductivity responds to high- frequency external disturbances. All of the effects considered appear to be very sensitive to the disturbance propagation direction and/or to that of the external magnetic field. Experimental possibilities of observing the described effects are discussed.

AI.tldr: 研究费米面几何中的精细特征（近圆柱状、近抛物面状条纹及局部扁平化）如何影响金属的电子及磁电性质，发现这些特征在特定条件下可显著改变常规金属或层状金属结构对高频外场扰动的响应。
AI.motivation: 费米面的精细几何特征可能对金属电子性质（尤其是磁电性质）有重要影响，但此前研究不足，需系统探讨这些特征的作用机制。
AI.method: 理论分析费米面几何中近圆柱状、近抛物面状条纹及局部扁平化等精细特征，考察其对电子性质（主要是磁电性质）的影响，重点关注高频外场扰动响应对传播方向和外部磁场方向的敏感性。
AI.result: 在特定条件下，这些精细特征能显著改变常规法向金属或层状金属结构对高频外场扰动的响应方式；所观测到的效应均强烈依赖于扰动传播方向和/或外加磁场方向。
AI.conclusion: 费米面精细几何特征可显著调控金属的高频电磁响应，且效应具有强方向依赖性；论文讨论了实验观测这些效应的可能性。

title: Complex Magnetic Phases and Unconventional Skyrmion Thermodynamics in Magnetically Intercalated Cr$_{1+x}$Te$_2$Compounds
summary: Chemical intercalation provides a powerful route for tuning the electronic and magnetic properties of transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs), enabling the emergence of magnetic phases and phenomena that are otherwise inaccessible in their pristine forms.
