Here, we investigate the structural, electronic, and magnetic properties of magnetically intercalated Cr$_{1+x}$Te$_2$ through a combination of scanning tunneling microscopy, angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, magnetization, electrical transport, and Lorentz transmission electron microscopy measurements. We uncover a rich magnetic phase diagram comprising paramagnetic, in-plane spin-fluctuation, out-of-plane ferromagnetic, and field-induced Néel-type skyrmion phases. In particular, Lorentz transmission electron microscopy directly reveals the formation of Néel-type skyrmion textures slightly below the Curie temperature, with their configurations evolving strongly with temperature and magnetic field. The skyrmions exhibit pronounced thermal hysteresis and coexist with stripe domains, indicative of a complex magnetic energy landscape arising from the competition among disorder-induced local Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions, perpendicular magnetic anisotropy, and dipolar interactions. Our results demonstrate that chemical intercalation can profoundly reshape the magnetic interactions and phase behavior of TMDs, establishing Cr$_{1+x}$Te$_2$ as a versatile platform for exploring tunable magnetism, skyrmion physics, and unconventional thermodynamic phenomena in low-dimensional quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 通过化学插层调控Cr$_{1+x}$Te$_2$的磁相互作用，发现顺磁、面内自旋涨落、垂直铁磁及场诱导Néel型斯格明子等多重磁相，为TMDs可调磁性与斯格明子物理提供平台。
AI.motivation: 化学插层可调控过渡金属硫属化合物(TMDs)的电子与磁性质，诱导本征态下无法出现的磁相；作者希望探究磁性插层后Cr$_{1+x}$Te$_2$的磁相图与拓扑磁结构。
AI.method: 结合扫描隧道显微镜、角分辨光电子能谱、磁化测量、电输运及洛伦兹透射电子显微镜多种手段，对磁插层Cr$_{1+x}$Te$_2$的结构、电子与磁性进行系统表征。
AI.result: 揭示包含顺磁、面内自旋涨落、垂直铁磁和场诱导Néel型斯格明子的丰富磁相图；洛伦兹TEM在略低于居里温度处直接观测到Néel型斯格明子，其构型随温度和磁场强烈演化，表现出明显热滞回并与条纹畴共存。
AI.conclusion: 化学插层可深刻重塑TMDs的磁相互作用与相行为；Cr$_{1+x}$Te$_2$成为探索可调磁性、斯格明子物理及低维量子材料中非常规热力学现象的多功能平台。

title: Numerical integration of intracule pair densities with optimized multicenter grids
summary: Intracule pair densities provide insight into electron correlation, but their routine analysis in extended systems is limited by the cost of numerical integration and the restriction of analytical methods to Gaussian basis functions. We present an efficient multicenter integration scheme for intracule densities and their moments. By adapting the topological fuzzy Voronoi cell formalism, we partition intracule space around interatomic displacement vectors, concentrating quadrature points near secondary density maxima that standard single-center grids poorly resolve. Benchmarks on linear alkanes show improved convergence with increasing molecular size, achieving relative errors below 0.02% in electron-electron repulsion energies with fewer quadrature points than single-center methods. The partitioning also enables the decomposition of global two-electron properties into spatial contributions associated with short- and long-range electron-pair separations. Coupling the multicenter grid with kernel density estimation reconstructs smooth radial intracule distributions at large interelectronic distances without the dense angular grids required by conventional surface integration. Validation on the S22 dataset supports the reliability of the method across diverse molecular systems. These developments facilitate intracule analysis in polyatomic systems and the investigation of electron correlation and dispersion interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于拓扑模糊Voronoi元胞的多中心积分方案，用于高效计算分子内禀配对密度及其矩，降低积分成本并提升收敛性。
AI.motivation: 内禀配对密度能揭示电子相关效应，但在扩展体系中因数值积分成本高、解析方法仅限于高斯基组，难以常规分析。
AI.method: 适配拓扑模糊Voronoi元胞形式，将内禀空间围绕原子间位移向量进行划分，使积分点集中于单中心网格难以解析的次级密度极大值附近；并结合核密度估计重构平滑径向内禀分布。
AI.result: 在线性烷烃基准测试中，随分子尺寸增大收敛性改善，电子-电子排斥能相对误差低于0.02%，且所需积分点少于单中心方法；可将全局双电子性质分解为短程与长程电子对分离的空间贡献；在S22数据集上验证可靠，无需传统表面积分所需的密集角度网格。
AI.conclusion: 该方法促进了多原子体系的内禀分析及电子相关与色散相互作用研究。

title: Learning ab initio phase-field models
summary: Simulating microstructure evolution requires quantum-mechanical accuracy and mesoscopic reach in length and time scales, a combination that no current method achieves. Classical phase-field models provide this reach, but their accuracy is limited by phenomenological free energies and mobilities. Here we develop a framework for learning ab initio phase-field models, where the mesoscopic equation is not postulated but derived from a Mori-Zwanzig projection of molecular dynamics onto species-density fields under explicit assumptions. The nonlocal free energy and mobility left unspecified by this equation are parametrized by neural networks and learned from short molecular dynamics trajectories generated with machine-learning interatomic potentials of ab initio accuracy. We demonstrate the framework on an iron-boron melt and on hydrogen-helium mixtures under planetary conditions. For iron-boron, the model shows that the melt at the FeB$_4$ composition is spinodally unstable at ambient pressure but stabilized at 10 GPa, offering a thermodynamic rationale for why FeB$_4$ has been synthesized only under high pressure. For hydrogen-helium, the model predicts the immiscibility boundary and captures droplet nucleation and growth in helium-rain simulations of a column corresponding to 2.2 million atoms, far beyond the scale of atomistic modeling at comparable accuracy. Trained across compositions and conditions, such models could provide a mesoscopic counterpart to ab initio molecular dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出从分子动力学出发、经Mori-Zwanzig投影推导相场方程，并用神经网络参数化自由能与迁移率，实现兼具从头算精度与介观尺度的微结构演化模拟。
AI.motivation: 微结构演化模拟需同时具备量子力学精度与介观时空尺度，但现有方法无法兼顾：经典相场模型可及介观尺度但精度受限于唯象自由能与迁移率。
AI.method: 不从假设出发，而是将分子动力学经Mori-Zwanzig投影到组分密度场上，在明确假设下导出介观方程；方程中未确定的非局域自由能与迁移率用神经网络参数化，并从机器学习原子间势生成的短时从头算精度MD轨迹中学习。
AI.result: 在铁硼熔体与行星条件下氢氦混合体系验证：FeB$_4$在常压下自旋分解不稳定、10 GPa下稳定，为仅高压合成提供热力学依据；氢氦体系预测不混溶边界，并在220万原子的氦雨模拟中捕捉液滴成核与生长，尺度远超同精度原子模拟。
AI.conclusion: 跨组分与条件训练的此类模型有望成为从头算分子动力学的介观对应物。

title: Hydrogen plasma-assisted atomic layer epitaxy of superconducting titanium nitride
summary: Atomic layer deposition (ALD) offers precise, conformal control of thin-film growth and is a workhorse for semiconductor manufacturing, but its use in superconducting quantum circuits is constrained by the need to simultaneously control crystallinity, stoichiometry and interfacial disorder at cryogenic temperatures. Here we develop hydrogen plasma assisted ALD to epitaxially grow superconducting titanium nitride (TiN) thin films, using a hydrogen plasma step to modify the surface chemistry to suppress precursor-derived impurities during each deposition cycle. Synchrotron X-ray scattering reveals semi-coherent epitaxy of TiN on c-plane sapphire, with discrete crystallographic domains and minimal long-range structural disorder. Complementary X-ray spectroscopy and neutron reflectometry show negligible oxygen-related disorder throughout the film and no substantial hydrogen incorporation. The resulting TiN films exhibit a superconducting transition at 2.2 K, a kinetic inductance of 15 pH/sq and a superconducting coherence length of 14.6 nm, comparable to the measured crystal coherence length. These results establish hydrogen plasma assisted ALD as a route to structurally ordered superconducting TiN thin film epitaxy and demonstrate that the nanoscale control of ALD can be extended to materials suitable for cryogenic quantum technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文开发氢等离子体辅助ALD外延生长超导TiN薄膜，实现低温量子电路所需的晶化、化学计量与界面有序控制。
AI.motivation: ALD在半导体制造中可实现精准保形薄膜生长，但用于超导量子电路时需在低温下同时控制结晶度、化学计量比和界面无序，传统ALD难以满足。
AI.method: 采用氢等离子体辅助ALD，在每沉积循环中用氢等离子体步骤修饰表面化学以抑制前驱体杂质；并用同步辐射X射线散射、X射线谱学和中子反射测量表征结构、氧杂质与氢含量。
AI.result: TiN在c面蓝宝石上实现半共格外延，具有离散晶域和极小长程无序；薄膜无明显氧相关无序、无显著氢掺入；超导转变温度2.2 K，动能电感15 pH/sq，超导相干长度14.6 nm，与晶体相干长度相当。
AI.conclusion: 氢等离子体辅助ALD可用于结构有序的超导TiN薄膜外延，表明ALD的纳米级控制可拓展至低温量子技术材料。

title: Robustness of the Verwey transition against remanent strain-induced defects in magnetite
summary: The Verwey transition in magnetite is a benchmark electronically driven phase transition that is highly sensitive to lattice imperfections and external perturbations. Doping, deviations from oxygen stoichiometry, and irradiation-induced point defects are known to lower the Verwey transition temperature, $T_{\rm V}$. By contrast, the role of remanent strain fields and extended defect structures generated by uniaxial stress has remained largely unexplored. Here we combine dark-field x-ray microscopy (DFXM) and ac magnetic susceptibility to determine how strain-induced defects affect the Verwey transition in stoichiometric single-crystalline magnetite after uniaxial compression and unloading. The DFXM measurements were performed on two samples compressed along the same $[011]$ direction: loading to $200~\mathrm{MPa}$ generated stable line-like defects and remanent strain fields, whereas loading beyond the fracture threshold produced denser defect networks and mechanical fracture. To test the effect of a different loading geometry, we also measured the ac susceptibility of a sample fractured by compression along $[001]$. Real-space DFXM imaging, lattice-orientation mapping, and residual strain mapping show substantial remanent structural disorder after compression. Nevertheless, neither the transition temperature $T_{\rm V}$ nor the sharpness of the transition changes measurably in any of the compressed or fractured samples. This behavior contrasts with the strong suppression of $T_{\rm V}$ by point-like disorder. Our results show that extended line-like defects and remanent strain fields produced by plastic deformation do not measurably perturb the macroscopic electronic ordering responsible for the Verwey transition, thereby distinguishing the effects of point defects from those of extended slip-related defects in magnetite.

AI.tldr: 本文结合暗场X射线显微镜与交流磁化率测量，研究单轴压缩引入的应变缺陷对磁铁矿Verwey转变的影响，发现扩展线状缺陷和残余应变场并不改变转变温度与锐度。
AI.motivation: Verwey转变对晶格缺陷和外部扰动高度敏感，点缺陷、掺杂及非化学计量比均会降低转变温度TV，但单轴应力产生的残余应变场和扩展缺陷结构的作用此前鲜有研究，需明确不同缺陷类型对电子有序的影响差异。
AI.method: 对化学计量单晶磁铁矿沿[011]方向进行单轴压缩：加载至200 MPa产生稳定线状缺陷与残余应变场，超过断裂阈值则产生更致密缺陷网络和机械断裂；另对沿[001]压缩断裂的样品进行交流磁化率测量。采用暗场X射线显微镜(DFXM)进行实空间成像、晶格取向映射和残余应变映射，并结合交流磁化率测定转变温度及锐度。
AI.result: DFXM成像与映射显示压缩后存在显著的残余结构无序，但所有压缩或断裂样品的Verwey转变温度TV及转变锐度均未发生可测量的变化，与点状缺陷强烈抑制TV的行为形成鲜明对比。
AI.conclusion: 塑性变形产生的扩展线状缺陷和残余应变场不会可测量地扰动导致Verwey转变的宏观电子有序，从而区分了磁铁矿中点缺陷与滑移相关扩展缺陷的不同效应。

title: Topological robustness of thermally disordered lattices: From average structures to ensemble electronic properties
comment: 23 pages, 7 figures. Data available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23067045
summary: Band topology is usually assigned to a single crystal structure, yet at finite temperature a crystal is an ensemble of thermally disordered configurations with a fluctuating band gap. We ask whether the thermally averaged structure is a faithful proxy for this ensemble, taking Bi$_2$Se$_3$ as a representative topological insulator and classifying band ordering in each ab initio molecular dynamics snapshot by scaling the spin-orbit coupling. The averaged structure fails in two ways: it misses the Rashba-like spin splitting that instantaneous symmetry breaking produces in individual configurations, and it substantially underestimates the band-gap renormalization, whereas a small ensemble of harmonic Monte Carlo configurations reproduces both the mean and the spread of the gap. Using a band-inversion survival probability, we find that the band inversion of Bi$_2$Se$_3$ holds in every sampled configuration up to 600 K, above which individual configurations cross into normal band ordering well before the average gap closes. Topological robustness at finite temperature is thus a property of the distribution over configurations rather than of any single structure.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑用热平均结构代表有限温度晶体能带拓扑的做法，以Bi₂Se₃为例，通过从头算分子动力学快照缩放自旋轨道耦合来分类能带顺序，发现平均结构无法捕捉瞬时对称破缺产生的Rashba型自旋劈裂，并严重低估带隙重整化。
AI.motivation: 能带拓扑通常被归属于单一晶体结构，但有限温度下晶体是热无序组态的集合，带隙存在涨落。作者要检验热平均结构是否能忠实代表这一组态集合。
AI.method: 以Bi₂Se₃为代表性拓扑绝缘体，对每个从头算分子动力学快照通过缩放自旋轨道耦合来分类能带顺序；并用少量谐波蒙特卡洛组态进行对比；引入能带反转存活概率刻画拓扑稳健性。
AI.result: 平均结构在两处失败：遗漏单组态中瞬时对称破缺产生的Rashba型自旋劈裂，且大幅低估带隙重整化。少量谐波蒙特卡洛组态能同时重现带隙的均值与分布。能带反转在600 K以下所有采样组态中均保持，超过600 K后部分组态在平均带隙闭合前就转入正常能带顺序。
AI.conclusion: 有限温度下的拓扑稳健性是组态分布的性质，而非任何单一结构的性质；热平均结构不是该组态集合的可靠代理。

title: Relativistic Hirshfeld atoms in a molecule: An information-theoretic view, with application to Drude oscillator dispersion models
summary: Several ad hoc dispersion models for density-functional theory are based on the use of Hirshfeld (or "stockholder") partition of a molecular charge density, which provides an in situ definition of atomic size. We show that a recently introduced "optimized" quantum Drude oscillator model for dispersion admits a closed-form solution in terms of the Lambert $W$ function, whose branches identify the compact and diffuse oscillator solutions. The compact solution determines the $C_8$ (dipole-quadrupole) dispersion coefficient analytically from the free-atom polarizability, $C_6$ coefficient, and van der Waals radius, without any reference $C_8$ data. Next, we provide a formal basis for a relativistic version of the atoms-in-molecule Hirshfeld partition. Using four-component Dirac-Hartree-Fock densities for isolated atoms defines a strictly positive deformation field that carries the relativistic changes in atomic density into the Hirshfeld partition. A uniqueness theorem for the non-relativistic case is extended to relativistic Hirshfeld atoms and admits an asymptotic expansion through quadratic order in the fine-structure constant. Normalization requires the relativistic density correction to reshape the reference atom while preserving its population. Finally, four-component polarizabilities and C6 coefficients are reported for closed-shell atoms and ions, which supply the reference data required to extend atoms-in-molecules dispersion models into the heavy-element regime. Periodic trends are observable in a scalar contraction factor that measures relativistic effects.

AI.tldr: 将色散模型中的量子Drude振子用Lambert W函数闭式求解，并建立相对论Hirshfeld原子划分理论，为含重元素的分子间色散模型提供参考数据。
AI.motivation: Hirshfeld（股东）电荷密度划分常用于密度泛函理论中的经验色散模型，可给出原子尺寸的原位定义。近期提出的"优化"量子Drude振子色散模型需要解析求解，同时原子-分子（AIM）色散模型扩展到重元素体系时缺少相对论参考数据与形式理论。
AI.method: 1) 对优化的量子Drude振子模型求Lambert W函数的闭式解，由分支识别紧致与弥散振子解，用自由原子极化率、C6系数和范德华半径解析确定C8色散系数。2) 以四分量Dirac-Hartree-Fock孤立原子密度构建严格正的形变场，将相对论密度变化引入Hirshfeld划分，并把非相对论唯一性定理推广到相对论情形，按精细结构常数做二阶渐近展开。3) 计算闭壳层原子与离子的四分量极化率和C6系数。
AI.result: 获得C8系数的解析表达式（无需参考C8数据）；相对论Hirshfeld原子具有唯一性并可按精细结构常数二阶展开；归一化要求相对论密度修正重塑参考原子但保持布居数；得到闭壳层原子与离子的四分量极化率与C6系数，并在标量收缩因子中观察到周期性趋势所反映的相对论效应。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为AIM色散模型提供了可解析求解的量子Drude框架和相对论Hirshfeld划分的理论基础与参考数据，使其可扩展至重元素体系。

title: Gate Control Improves Routing Efficiency for Periodic Traffic
summary: Traffic movement on highways and data packet transmission across the Internet serve as prototypical examples of collective dynamical behavior in complex systems. Although enhancing traffic flow in complex networks has been extensively investigated, most existing studies focus on single-queue models. In this paper, we introduce a simple yet effective two-queue scheme with gate control that regulates vehicle entry and integrates it with the routing protocol. When vehicles arrive at a on-ramp gate, they first join a waiting queue and are permitted to enter the main flowing queue once it has emptied. This two-queue strategy is especially advantageous when highway inflow varies periodically with large fluctuations, as is commonly observed in real traffic. Moreover, it modifies the system's failure characteristics, replacing sudden, discontinuous jamming transitions with gradual, continuous ones. The approach is based on a simple rule using only local queue information, making it easy to implement and widely applicable. Beyond the specific setup studied here, it can be applied to other transportation networks under different conditions or extended to other queuing systems, such as Internet data packet routing.

AI.tldr: 提出一种双队列门控方案，通过调节车辆进入并结合路由协议，改善周期性大幅波动下的高速公路交通流，使拥堵转变由突变变为渐变。
AI.motivation: 现有复杂网络交通流研究多聚焦单队列模型，难以应对高速公路入流周期性大幅波动等真实场景，缺乏简单有效的调节机制。
AI.method: 引入带闸门控制的双队列方案：车辆到达匝道闸门时先进入等待队列，待主流动队列清空后才被允许进入，并与路由协议集成。该规则仅依赖局部队列信息。
AI.result: 在入流周期性大幅波动时该策略优势明显；系统失效特性被改变，原本突然、不连续的拥堵相变转变为渐进、连续的相变。
AI.conclusion: 该方案规则简单、易实现且适用广泛，可推广至不同条件下的其他交通网络，或扩展至互联网数据包路由等排队系统。

title: Charge and spin dynamics in spintronic THz emitters from Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory
summary: Spintronic terahertz (THz) emitters based on ferromagnet/heavy-metal heterostructures provide efficient broadband sources of THz radiation, yet the microscopic relation between ultrafast spin transport and charge redistribution remains incompletely understood. Here, we employ time-dependent density functional theory to resolve the coupled charge, spin, and magnetization dynamics of Co/Pt and Co/W bilayers in real time and space. Despite qualitatively similar interlayer spin-current dynamics, the two heterostructures exhibit markedly different interlayer charge transfer: Co/Pt shows a relatively small and partially reversed transfer from Pt to Co, whereas Co/W exhibits a larger and persistent transfer from Co to W. We trace these differences to the material-dependent ground-state electronic structure and the spin- and orbital-resolved phase space accessible to photoexcited carriers. Spin-resolved dynamics further reveal coexisting spin-orbit-mediated redistribution and optically induced intersite spin transfer, including a delayed minority-spin transfer from the heavy metal to Co common to both systems. While net electronic spin angular momentum is transferred between the layers, we find no corresponding net transfer of electronic orbital angular momentum. In Co/W, the persistent redistribution of electronic density from interstitial to atom-centered states additionally provides strong evidence for light-induced electronic localization. These results demonstrate that ultrafast spin transport does not uniquely determine charge or angular-momentum redistribution in spintronic THz emitters, which instead depends critically on the material-specific electronic phase space.

AI.tldr: 本文用时间依赖密度泛函理论实时、实空间地解析Co/Pt与Co/W双层膜中耦合的电荷、自旋与磁化动力学，揭示超快自旋输运并不唯一决定电荷与角动量再分布，而是取决于材料特定的电子相空间。
AI.motivation: 自旋电子太赫兹发射器（铁磁/重金属异质结）虽能提供高效宽带太赫兹源，但超快自旋输运与电荷再分布之间的微观关联仍不清楚。
AI.method: 采用时间依赖密度泛函理论（TDDFT），在真实时间与空间尺度上解析Co/Pt和Co/W双层膜的电荷、自旋与磁化动力学，并结合自旋与轨道分辨的相空间分析。
AI.result: 两种异质结层间自旋流动力学定性相似，但层间电荷转移差异显著：Co/Pt呈较小且部分反向的Pt→Co转移，Co/W则呈较大且持续的Co→W转移。自旋分辨动力学显示共存的自旋轨道介导再分布与光致跨位点自旋转移，二者均有延迟的少数组分自旋由重金属向Co转移。层间存在净电子自旋角动量转移，但无净电子轨道角动量转移。Co/W中电子密度从间隙态向原子中心态的持续再分布，为光致电子局域化提供了强证据。
AI.conclusion: 超快自旋输运并不唯一决定自旋电子太赫兹发射器中的电荷或角动量再分布，后者关键取决于材料特定的电子相空间。

title: Na$_2$Ir$^\text{IV}$Cl$_6$: The Missing Member of the Perfectly Cubic Vacancy Ordered $A_2$IrCl$_6$ Family, Another Potential $J_{eff}$ = $\frac{1}{2}$ Ground State Candidate
summary: Vacancy ordered double perovskites (VODPs) have been known for more than 100 years, but their exact crystal structures and magnetic ground state remained controversial till date. Anhydrous VODP iridates ($A_2$Ir$X_6$; $A$ = K$^+$, (NH$_4$)$^+$, Cs$^+$, Rb$^+$, and $X$ = F$^-$, Cl$^-$, Br$^-$), having $face-centered~cubic$ (fcc) antiferromagnetic ground state, offer a chemically well-defined platform to investigate the influence of on-site Coulomb repulsion, crystal field, spin-orbit coupling, and competing Heisenberg and Kitaev interactions. Interestingly, among these, the Na-based VODP iridates seem to possess an unusual hydration dependent structural and magnetic uncertainty. As a result, a cubic Na$_2$IrCl$_6$ system having fcc antiferromagnetism could not be stabilized ever. Here, for the first time, we report the synthesis and comprehensive characterization of anhydrous Na$_2$IrCl$_6$ single crystals having fcc structure with antiferromagnetic transition temperature of 1.91 K. Thermogravimetric analysis establishes the absence of lattice water and also demonstrates thermal stability of the crystals up to 453 K. The cubic phase reported here contrasts with previously described 'anhydrous' monoclinic Na$_2$IrCl$_6$ and highlights the strong structural and physical property relationship in Na-based VODP iridates. This new material offers an exciting playing ground for exploring another potential perfect $J_{eff}$ = $\frac{1}{2}$ octahedra and the consequent strong Kitaev interaction within the nearest-neighbor (nn) pairs of Ir ions.

AI.tldr: 首次合成出无水Na₂IrCl₆单晶，具fcc结构与1.91 K反铁磁转变，挑战了此前认为其单斜、无法稳定立方的观点。
AI.motivation: 空位有序双钙钛矿(VODP)铱酸盐的精确结构与磁基态长期存在争议，其中Na基体系因水合依赖的结构与磁性不确定性，立方Na₂IrCl₆从未被稳定。
AI.method: 合成无水Na₂IrCl₆单晶，并通过综合表征(含热重分析)确定其结构、热稳定性与磁性。
AI.result: 获得fcc结构无水Na₂IrCl₆单晶，反铁磁转变温度1.91 K；TGA证实无晶格水，晶体热稳定至453 K；立方相与以往报道的"无水"单斜Na₂IrCl₆形成对比。
AI.conclusion: 凸显Na基VODP铱酸盐中结构与物性的强关联，为探索理想J_eff=1/2八面体及近邻Ir间强Kitaev相互作用提供新平台。

title: Layer-by-layer growth of highly aligned MoS$_2$ nanoribbon arrays
summary: One-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides (TMD) nanoribbons (NRs) offer a promising route to aggressive channel-width scaling in nanoscale transistors. However, controlling their layer number, a key determinant of device performance, has remained elusive. Here, we demonstrate a chemical vapor deposition (CVD) approach for layer-by-layer growth of MoS$_2$ NRs on a low-symmetry sapphire surface. This approach enables the oriented growth of single-crystalline bilayer NRs with a 2H stacking configuration, while maintaining widths below 20 nm. Increasing the MoO$_3$ precursor supply was found to be crucial for promoting the growth of the second and subsequent layers. By controlling the growth time and precursor supply, the layer number of MoS$_2$ NRs can be increased up to four layers. This method can also be extended to the growth of vertical MoS$_2$/WS$_2$ hetero-NRs. The average carrier mobility and current density of bilayer NR field-effect transistors (FETs) are two- and three-times higher than those of monolayer counterparts, respectively, and a maximum mobility of 86.7 cm$^2$V$^{-1}$s$^{-1}$ was attained with a bilayer NR-FET. These results highlight layer number as a key parameter for optimizing NR device performance. Our thickness-controlled growth strategy provides a general route towards TMD NR-based transistors with enhanced scalability and performance.

AI.tldr: 该文通过CVD在蓝宝石衬底上实现MoS2纳米带层数可控生长（1-4层），并证明双层器件性能显著优于单层。
AI.motivation: 一维TMD纳米带是实现纳米晶体管沟道宽度缩小的有前景路径，但其层数（决定器件性能的关键因素）难以控制。
AI.method: 采用CVD方法在低对称性蓝宝石表面逐层生长MoS2纳米带；通过增加MoO3前驱体供给并调控生长时间来增加层数，并扩展到垂直MoS2/WS2异质纳米带生长。
AI.result: 实现单晶双层2H堆垛纳米带的定向生长，宽度<20 nm，层数可达四层；双层纳米带FET的平均载流子迁移率和电流密度分别是单层的2倍和3倍，最大迁移率达86.7 cm²V⁻¹s⁻¹。
AI.conclusion: 层数是优化纳米带器件性能的关键参数，该厚度可控生长策略为高性能、可规模化TMD纳米带晶体管提供了通用途径。

title: State-selective molecular orientation by vibrational Autler-Townes adiabatic passage
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures for manuscript; 7pages, 4 figures for supplemental material
summary: Control of molecular angular momentum orientation enables state-resolved studies of molecular interactions and provides a basis for quantum information processing. Here we propose all-optical Autler-Townes state-selective adiabatic passage (ASAP) to prepare molecules in a single $|J,M\rangle$ sublevel. An Autler-Townes branch created by a strong coupling field is selectively populated and adiabatically mapped onto the target vibrational state. We resolve detuning-dependent rovibrational Autler-Townes splitting in $^{13}$CO$_2$, establishing the spectroscopic basis for the selective excitation of the target dressed branch. The density-matrix model calibrated by these spectra predicts transfer approaching 90\%. The scheme can exploit millisecond vibrational radiative lifetimes within the electronic ground state and extend to polar and nonpolar molecules with infrared-active vibrational modes.

AI.tldr: 提出全光Autler-Townes态选择性绝热通道（ASAP）方案，用于将分子制备到单一|J,M⟩子能级，理论上转移效率接近90%。
AI.motivation: 分子角动量取向的操控对态分辨的分子相互作用研究和量子信息处理具有重要意义，需要将分子精确制备到单一|J,M⟩子能级。
AI.method: 利用强耦合场产生的Autler-Townes分支进行选择性布居，并绝热映射到目标振动态；在¹³CO₂中测量了依赖于失谐的振转Autler-Townes劈裂，建立选择性激发目标缀饰分支的光谱基础，并用密度矩阵模型标定。
AI.result: 在¹³CO₂中分辨出失谐依赖的振转Autler-Townes劈裂；经光谱标定的密度矩阵模型预测转移效率接近90%。
AI.conclusion: 该方案可利用电子基态内毫秒级振动辐射寿命，并可推广至具有红外活性振动模式的极性和非极性分子。

title: Optimal sampling strategies in event-chain Monte Carlo
summary: Event-chain Monte Carlo (ECMC) has revolutionised computational sampling over recent years, providing a powerful alternative to the molecular-dynamics (MD) and Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) algorithms. Each method outperforms the ubiquitous random-walk Metropolis algorithm by advancing particles along deterministic trajectories, but ECMC achieves this without being constrained by Newtonian dynamics. Recent advances exploited this dynamical freedom to induce a collective particle dynamics that relax local density variations on fast timescales. In a foundational model of $N$ pairwise-interacting particles on the 1D torus, this led to an $O(N^{3/4})$ improvement on the industry-leading computational efficiency of MD and HMC - but with an impractically small prefactor at low/high mean particle density for general attractive/repulsive interactions. Here we present a universal framework that generalises this high-efficiency sampling strategy to all translationally symmetric pairwise models on the torus - creating the potential to surpass MD and HMC as the state of the art. We also numerically elucidate the collective particle dynamics and discuss broad impact across the physical sciences and computational statistics.

AI.tldr: 提出通用框架，将高效ECMC采样策略推广到环面上所有平移对称成对模型。
AI.motivation: ECMC相较MD/HMC有动力学自由，此前在一维环面成对相互作用模型中通过集体粒子动力学获得O(N^{3/4})效率提升，但在一般吸引/排斥相互作用下，低/高平均粒子密度时前置因子过小而不实用。
AI.method: 构建一个通用框架，将此前的高效采样策略推广至环面上所有平移对称的成对相互作用模型，并数值阐明集体粒子动力学。
AI.result: 该框架克服了原方法前置因子过小的限制，有望使ECMC超越MD和HMC成为最先进的采样方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作对物理科学与计算统计领域具有广泛影响。

title: Gate Dispersive Charge Detection in Ge/SiGe Quantum Dots
summary: Spin qubits are an attractive platform for scalable quantum information processing, and recently, laterally gated quantum dots (QDs) in Ge heterostructures have emerged as a leading implementation of spin qubits. To date, RF single-hole transistors (SHT) and integrated superconducting resonators have been used for spin and charge readout, but their size can pose challenges. Here we demonstrate compact RF gate-dispersive charge readout of a Ge double QD (DQD), and a single hole box (SHB)-DQD system. We resolve QD loading and interdot transitions with both techniques. We find that the SHB enhances the interdot signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of our 540 MHz circuit by a factor of 20 for a DQD coupling $t_c \approx 5$ GHz, providing a unity-SNR at 135 microseconds, c.f. for 2.7 miliseconds for the direct detection. Power- and temperature-dependent measurements verify that SNR is limited by dielectric loss which compromises impedance matching. These results establish a compact readout approach based on gate-dispersive detection for Ge/SiGe heterostructure QDs.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了一种紧凑的射频栅极色散电荷读出方法，用于Ge双量子点及单空穴盒-量子点系统，将互点信号信噪比提升20倍。
AI.motivation: Ge异质结中的侧栅量子点是自旋量子比特的重要平台，但现有射频单空穴晶体管和集成超导谐振器读出方案尺寸较大，存在集成挑战，因此需要更紧凑的读出方式。
AI.method: 采用射频栅极色散电荷读出技术，对Ge双量子点以及单空穴盒-双量子点系统进行测量，分辨量子点加载与互点跃迁；使用540 MHz电路，并通过功率和温度依赖性测量分析噪声来源。
AI.result: 在耦合tc≈5 GHz时，单空穴盒将540 MHz电路的互点信噪比提升20倍，单位信噪比时间从直接探测的2.7 ms降至135 μs；功率与温度测量表明信噪比受介电损耗限制，影响了阻抗匹配。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了基于栅极色散探测的紧凑读出方案，适用于Ge/SiGe异质结量子点，为自旋量子比特的可扩展读出提供了新途径。

title: Room-temperature Magnetoelastic Coupling in UIr$_4$Al$_{15}$
summary: The interplay between electronic and structural degrees of freedom underpins many emergent phenomena in quantum materials, yet magnetoelastic coupling in metallic systems is typically weak and confined to low temperatures or microscopic length scales. Here, we report giant magnetoelastic coupling slightly above room temperature in the uranium-based intermetallic compound UIr$_4$Al$_{15}$. Using temperature-dependent single-crystal X-ray diffraction together with anisotropic magnetic susceptibility measurements, we directly resolve subtle but reproducible structural distortions coupled to magnetic alignment. Despite the absence of crystallographic symmetry breaking, pronounced anomalies emerge in lattice parameters and selected chemical bond distances near the magnetic transition region, revealing an unusual sensitivity of the crystal structure to magnetic orientation. The coupling enables direct probing of how atomic distances and local chemical bonding govern the electronic and magnetic states in a bulk intermetallic material. Our results establish UIr$_4$Al$_{15}$ as a rare platform in which magnetism and lattice distortions are strongly intertwined near room temperature, opening new opportunities for magnetically responsive quantum materials and functional magnetic sensing applications.

AI.tldr: 在铀基金属间化合物 UIr₄Al₁₅ 中，研究者于略高于室温处发现了巨大的磁弹性耦合，其结构畸变与磁取向强烈耦合。
AI.motivation: 金属体系中的磁弹性耦合通常较弱，且局限于低温或微观尺度。作者希望探索是否存在强耦合的金属材料，并理解电子、结构自由度与磁性之间的交织如何驱动量子材料中的涌现现象。
AI.method: 结合变温单晶 X 射线衍射与各向异性磁化率测量，直接分辨与磁有序耦合的细微可重复结构畸变，并分析晶格参数与特定化学键键长的异常。
AI.result: 在磁性转变区域附近，虽无晶体学对称性破缺，晶格参数和部分化学键键长仍出现显著异常，显示晶体结构对磁取向具有异常敏感性，并实现了对原子间距和局域化学键调控电子与磁态的直接探测。
AI.conclusion: UIr₄Al₁₅ 是一个在近室温下磁性与晶格畸变强耦合的罕见平台，为磁响应量子材料及功能性磁传感应用开辟了新机会。

title: HVPE Homoepitaxy of $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$: High-Temperature Growth and Orientation-Dependent Surface Evolution
summary: In this work, we systematically investigate homoepitaxial $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ growth by halide vapor phase epitaxy (HVPE) on (010), (001), and ($\bar{2}$01) native substrates over a broad growth parameter space, extending the growth temperature as high as 1150 $^\circ$C. The growth kinetics exhibit strong dependence on precursor supply, temperature, reactor pressure, and Ga-source-to-substrate distance. Increasing the HCl flow from 80 to 300 sccm enhances the growth rate by up to seven-fold, while increasing the temperature from 1050 to 1150 $^\circ$C nearly doubles the deposition rate. At 1150 $^\circ$C, atmospheric-pressure growth yields rates more than 2.5 times higher than those at 100 Torr, while reducing the O$_2$ flow to 5 sccm further increases the growth rate to 14.3 $μ$m/h, producing films up to 42.9 $μ$m thick in 3 h. Notably, phase-pure homoepitaxial layers with good crystalline quality are obtained across all three orientations, with low rocking-curve full width at half maximum (FWHM) values of 63.4, 66.6, and 42.8 arcsec for the (010), (001), and ($\bar{2}$01) epilayers, respectively. The surface morphology exhibits a pronounced crystallographic dependence and evolves strongly with the HVPE growth conditions. In particular, the ($\bar{2}$01) surface develops well-defined step-and-terrace morphology with local RMS roughness as low as 0.17 nm. These results extend $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ HVPE homoepitaxy into a higher-temperature regime and demonstrate a broad process window for high-rate growth of thick, high-quality epilayers with strongly orientation-dependent surface evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了HVPE法在(010)、(001)、(2̅01)衬底上同质外延β-Ga₂O₃，将生长温度提升至1150°C，实现了高速率、高质量厚膜生长。
AI.motivation: 需要拓展β-Ga₂O₃的HVPE同质外延至更高温区，并厘清生长参数对生长动力学和表面形貌的影响，以获得高速率、高质量的厚外延层。
AI.method: 在(010)、(001)、(2̅01)原生衬底上，于宽广参数空间内进行HVPE同质外延，最高温度达1150°C，系统调节HCl流量、温度、反应室压力、O₂流量及镓源-衬底距离。
AI.result: HCl流量从80增至300 sccm使生长速率提高达7倍；温度从1050升至1150°C使沉积速率近乎翻倍；1150°C常压生长速率比100 Torr高2.5倍以上，O₂降至5 sccm时速率达14.3 μm/h，3小时可生长42.9 μm厚膜。三个取向均获得相纯、结晶质量良好的外延层，摇摆曲线FWHM分别为63.4、66.6、42.8 arcsec。(2̅01)表面呈现良好台阶形貌，局部RMS粗糙度低至0.17 nm。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将β-Ga₂O₃的HVPE同质外延拓展至更高温区，展示了高速率生长厚层高质量外延层的宽工艺窗口，并揭示出强烈的取向依赖表面演化。

title: PyCDFT: A Python-scriptable library for analytical evaluation of orbital conceptual density (matrix) functional theory
summary: Conceptual density functional theory (CDFT) defines chemical reactivity descriptors as derivatives of the electronic energy with respect to the number of electrons and the external potential, or combinations thereof; in practice, however, researchers almost always replace these derivatives with finite-difference and frontier-orbital approximations, and no common software exists for their analytical evaluation. We present PyCDFT, to our knowledge, the first standardized, open-source, and scriptable code that analytically computes the descriptors of conceptual density (matrix) functional theory for ground and excited states up to second order, including the orbital hardness, the Fukui function and Fukui matrix, and the linear response function, from a single converged mean-field wavefunction imported from virtually any electronic-structure package. The descriptors are obtained from matrix-free, preconditioned Krylov-subspace solutions of the coupled-perturbed self-consistent-field equations for both spin-unpolarized and spin-polarized references, with the work distributed over MPI ranks and all data flowing through a single HDF5 checkpoint file that supports restart, post-processing, and the export of real-space descriptors as cube files for visualization. The design delegates integrals, grids, and exchange-correlation kernels to PySCF and Libxc, keeping the library compact, user-friendly, and interoperable. Worked examples on the ground state of H$_2$O and a broken-symmetry $Δ$SCF excited state of NH$_3$ show that a complete second-order CDFT analysis requires only a few lines of user code.

AI.tldr: PyCDFT是首个标准化、开源的脚本化工具，可对基态和激发态解析计算概念密度泛函理论（矩阵）描述符至二阶，包括轨道硬度、Fukui函数/矩阵和线性响应函数。
AI.motivation: CDFT用电子能量对电子数和外势的导数定义化学活性描述符，但实际研究中几乎都用有限差分和前线轨道近似替代这些导数，且缺乏解析求解的通用软件。
AI.method: 从任意电子结构软件导入单个收敛平均场波函数，通过无矩阵、预条件Krylov子空间方法求解耦合微扰自洽场方程（支持自旋非极化和自旋极化参考），用MPI分配工作负载，数据经单一HDF5检查点文件流动以支持重启、后处理和导出实空间描述符为cube文件；积分、网格和交换关联核委托PySCF和Libxc。
AI.result: 在H2O基态和NH3的破对称ΔSCF激发态上验证，完整二阶CDFT分析仅需几行用户代码。
AI.conclusion: PyCDFT提供了标准化、紧凑、易用且互操作的CDFT解析计算方案，弥补了现有工具缺失，并支持基态与激发态的二阶描述符计算。

title: Scalar field theory for (chiral) active Brownian particles: bottom-up derivation revisited
summary: The active Brownian particle (ABP) model is one of the most widely used particle-based models in studies of scalar active fluids. A collection of interacting ABPs is known to exhibit intriguing phenomena that are absent in equilibrium counterparts. A prominent example is spontaneous phase separation, known as motility-induced phase separation (MIPS), which occurs even in the absence of explicit attractive interactions. In parallel, the large-scale behavior of scalar active fluids is often modeled using continuum descriptions, namely, scalar field theories. Such scalar active field theories are usually formulated in a top-down manner, and establishing their connections to particle-based models remains challenging, with these connections not yet fully understood. To advance the microscopic derivation of scalar active field theories, we revisit the connection between ABPs interacting via a two-body potential in two dimensions and scalar field theories that include all possible terms up to fourth order in spatial gradients. Our approach is based on a pressure expansion and the renormalization group (RG) method in the context of singular perturbation theory. The RG method provides a systematic way to eliminate fast variables and identify the dynamics on the slow invariant manifold. Within this framework, scalar field theories can be obtained as RG flow equations. We also apply this method to a chiral variant of the ABP model, the chiral ABP (cABP) model, in which a constant torque biases particle rotation to the left or right. We show that the scalar field theory corresponding to the cABP model contains two ``odd'' terms in addition to those present in the scalar field theory for ABPs. The method developed here may also be useful for deriving hydrodynamic descriptions of other types of active matter systems.

AI.tldr: 本文用压力展开和重整化群(RG)方法，从微观两体相互作用的ABP粒子模型系统地推导标量活性场论（含至四阶空间梯度项），并推广到手性ABP模型。
AI.motivation: 标量活性场论多采用自顶向下方式构建，其与粒子模型的联系尚不清晰、理解不完整。为推进标量活性场论的微观推导，作者重新审视二维两体势相互作用ABP与标量场论之间的关系。
AI.method: 基于压力展开与奇异微扰理论下的重整化群(RG)方法。RG方法可系统消除快变量并识别慢不变流形上的动力学，标量场论可作为RG流方程获得。方法还应用于手性ABP(cABP)模型（恒定扭矩偏置粒子旋转方向）。
AI.result: 将ABP模型与包含至四阶空间梯度所有可能项的标量场论建立联系；cABP对应的标量场论在ABP场论基础上额外包含两个"odd"（奇）项。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功实现了从粒子模型到标量活性场论的微观推导，并揭示手性带来的额外奇项；所发展的方法或可用于推导其他活性物质系统的流体力学描述。

title: Nutational Spin Pumping and Dissipation
summary: At terahertz drive frequencies, magnetization dynamics enter an inertial regime beyond the scope of standard Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG) theory. We reveal a nutational damping torque comprising a bulk term and an interfacial contribution that describes spin emission into adjacent metals. The interfacial term generates nutational spin pumping: a dc spin current that scales quadratically with the drive frequency. Using a scattering approach, we relate this effect to microscopic material parameters and predict pronounced enhancements in ultrathin films and low-Fermi-energy conductors. Nutational spin pumping can be detected directly via the inverse spin Hall effect or indirectly via thickness-dependent renormalization of nutational damping.

AI.tldr: 在太赫兹驱动下，磁化动力学进入惯性区，作者揭示由体项与界面项组成的章动阻尼力矩，其中界面项产生与驱动频率平方成正比的直流自旋流（章动自旋泵浦），并预测其在超薄膜与低费米能导体中显著增强。
AI.motivation: 太赫兹频段磁化动力学超出标准LLG理论范围，进入惯性（章动）区，现有理论无法描述该区域的自旋输运与阻尼机制，因此需要建立新的理论框架。
AI.method: 提出包含体项和界面贡献的章动阻尼力矩理论，界面项描述自旋向相邻金属的发射；采用散射方法将章动自旋泵浦效应与微观材料参数关联。
AI.result: 章动自旋泵浦产生直流自旋流，其大小与驱动频率的平方成正比；在超薄膜和低费米能导体中该效应显著增强；可通过逆自旋霍尔效应直接探测，或通过厚度依赖的章动阻尼重整化间接探测。
AI.conclusion: 章动自旋泵浦为太赫兹频段惯性磁化动力学提供新的自旋输运机制，连接微观材料参数与可测量信号，并指出超薄膜与低费米能导体为理想观测体系。

title: Mass-asymmetry-controlled exciton dressing and dissociation in a quantum lattice model
summary: In a polar material, a neutral exciton couples to phonons through the sum of the electron and hole deformation potentials. Because the total source vanishes by charge neutrality, the elastic exciton-phonon vertex is regularized by electron-hole interference. Here we determine the non-perturbative fate of this interference by exact diagonalization of a Holstein-exciton model. By parameterizing the mass asymmetry to decouple it from the small-polaron atomic limit, we map a regime map comprising an internal dressing crossover and a dissociation boundary. We prove analytically and verify numerically that for equal masses, the symmetric exciton ground state is protected from phonon dressing by an exact exchange selection rule, provided the phonon source is odd under electron-hole exchange (the neutral case). As mass asymmetry increases, this selection rule is broken and the exciton acquires a strong local polaronic cloud. We show that the dissociation boundary, conversely, is set by a global energy balance between Coulomb binding and polaronic stabilization, and is nearly independent of the internal dressing. Paradoxically, the very symmetry that protects the exciton from dressing denies it polaronic stabilization, driving it toward dissociation at strong coupling. We discuss these results in the context of lattice exciton-polaron models and their implications for sharp versus broad excitonic lines in mass-symmetric versus mass-asymmetric polar semiconductors.

AI.tldr: 通过Holstein-exciton模型的精确对角化，研究极化材料中激子-声子耦合的非微扰行为，揭示质量对称性既保护激子免受声子修饰、又使其失去极化子稳定化而趋于解离的悖论。
AI.motivation: 极化材料中中性激子通过电子与空穴形变势之和耦合声子，但因电荷中性总源项消失，弹性激子-声子顶点由电子-空穴干涉调控。作者希望确定这种干涉在非微扰情形下的最终命运，并厘清内部修饰与解离之间的关系。
AI.method: 对Holstein-exciton模型进行精确对角化；通过参数化质量不对称性，将其与小极化子原子极限解耦，绘制包含内部修饰交叉与解离边界的相图；对等质量情形进行解析证明并数值验证。
AI.result: 对于等质量情形，若声子源在电子-空穴交换下为奇（中性情形），对称激子基态受精确交换选择规则保护，不被声子修饰；质量不对称增大时选择规则被打破，激子获得强局域极化子云；解离边界由库仑束缚与极化子稳定化的全局能量平衡决定，几乎独立于内部修饰。
AI.conclusion: 保护激子免受修饰的对称性同时也剥夺了其极化子稳定化，从而在强耦合下驱动其解离。该结果在格点激子-极化子模型背景下讨论，并对质量对称与非对称极性半导体中激子谱线的锐利与展宽具有启示。

title: Train for Accuracy, Execute at Scale: Architecture-Preserving Inference for Equivariant Atomistic Foundation Models
summary: Equivariant atomistic foundation models provide broadly transferable interatomic potentials trained against quantum-mechanical reference data, but their repeated execution at simulation scale remains computationally and memory intensive. We present Symmetrix-XL, an inference engine that scales pretrained MACE checkpoints without retraining, distillation, or modification of their learned weights. It combines streamed-edge execution to avoid graph-wide materialization of expanded edge intermediates, model-specialized code generation to compile checkpoint-specific operators, and tiled execution to reuse a bounded device-memory workspace. On complete LAMMPS-step benchmarks, Symmetrix-XL reduces inference time by 3.1-5.0 times relative to ML-IAP + cuEquivariance across tested A100 and RTX 5090 workloads. On a single A100 80 GB GPU, the tested MACE-OMAT-0 capacity boundary increases from 24,565 atoms to 11.24 million atoms. This substantially lowers the hardware threshold for simulations that would otherwise require spatial decomposition across many GPUs and compute nodes. The same backend weak-scales to 703 million atoms on 64 A800 GPUs at 93.8 percent efficiency. Energy, force, stress, molecular-dynamics stability, and Matbench Discovery evaluations reproduce reference MACE behavior within measured tolerances. Case studies spanning solid-state, interfacial, and reactive systems demonstrate the increased capacity in realistic workflows. These results establish post-training execution as a scaling axis complementary to model redesign, compression, and distributed scale-out, and show that the practical accuracy-cost frontier depends on both model architecture and inference execution.

AI.tldr: Symmetrix-XL 是一个无需重训练或蒸馏即可扩展预训练 MACE 等变原子基础模型的推理引擎，通过流式边执行、模型专用代码生成和分块执行实现大幅提速与容量扩展。
AI.motivation: 等变原子基础模型（如 MACE）虽具备良好迁移性，但在模拟规模下反复执行时计算和内存开销巨大，硬件门槛高，常需多 GPU 空间分解。
AI.method: 提出 Symmetrix-XL，结合三点技术：(1) 流式边执行，避免全图物化扩展边中间量；(2) 模型专用代码生成，编译针对特定检查点的算子；(3) 分块执行，复用有界设备内存工作区。全程不重训练、不蒸馏、不修改权重。
AI.result: 在完整 LAMMPS 步基准上，A100 与 RTX 5090 上推理时间相对 ML-IAP + cuEquivariance 降低 3.1-5.0 倍；单张 A100 80GB 上 MACE-OMAT-0 容量上限从 24,565 原子提升至 1124 万原子；64 张 A800 上弱扩展至 7.03 亿原子，效率 93.8%；能量、力、应力、MD 稳定性和 Matbench Discovery 评估均在测量容差内复现参考行为。
AI.conclusion: 训练后执行是独立于模型重设计、压缩和分布式扩展的又一扩展维度，实际精度-成本前沿取决于模型架构与推理执行的共同作用。

title: Nonadiabatic Quantum Dynamics of Hexatriene via the Extended Hubbard-Peierls Model and Time-Dependent DMRG
summary: Propagating the electronic and nuclear degrees of freedom of a molecule simultaneously is a challenging task, because the number of vibronic states grows exponentially with system size. We use the adaptive time-dependent density matrix renormalization group to perform simulations of the extended Hubbard-Peierls Hamiltonian, in which both the electronic and nuclear degrees of freedom are quantized. We describe our approach, and demonstrate it through converged calculations of the nonadiabatic dynamics of hexatriene. This simulation predicts a lifetime of the `bright' $\mathrm{1B_u}$ electronic state of approximately 40 fs. Our predictions for the population of the $\mathrm{1B_u}$ electronic state are in qualitative agreement with those obtained using the linear vibronic coupling model derived from the extended Hubbard-Peierls Hamiltonian in previous work.

AI.tldr: 使用自适应含时密度矩阵重正化群模拟扩展Hubbard-Peierls哈密顿量，同时量子化电子与核自由度，成功计算了己三烯的非绝热动力学，预测1B_u明态寿命约40 fs。
AI.motivation: 同时传播分子的电子与核自由度极其困难，因为振动-电子（vibronic）态数目随体系尺寸指数增长，传统方法难以处理。
AI.method: 采用自适应含时密度矩阵重正化群（adaptive time-dependent DMRG），在电子与核自由度均被量子化的扩展Hubbard-Peierls哈密顿量框架下进行模拟。
AI.result: 通过对己三烯非绝热动力学的收敛计算验证了方法，预测"亮"1B_u电子态寿命约40 fs；1B_u态布居结果与已有基于线性振动耦合模型的预测定性一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明自适应含时DMRG可有效处理电子-核耦合的非绝热动力学，结果与线性振动耦合模型吻合，验证了方法的可靠性。

title: Synthesis of Metal-Semiconductor Heterojunctions in Single Graphene Nanoribbons
summary: Graphene nanoribbons (GNRs) are a highly tunable class of one-dimensional (1D) quantum materials that can be fabricated through bottom-up synthesis. Precise control over GNR band gaps and band-edge alignments has established them as a promising nanoelectronics platform, but forming high-quality electronic interfaces remains challenging. Here we combine sequential on-surface synthesis and scanning tunneling microscopy (STM)-induced dehydrogenation to directly write metallic 7-iGNR segments into otherwise semiconducting H$_2$-7-iGNRs without changing the GNR width or carbon backbone connectivity. The resulting metallic segments exhibit nonzero spectral weight at the Fermi level ($E_\mathrm{F}$) and spatially extended electronic states, consistent with two dispersive bands crossing $E_\mathrm{F}$. The new metallic states are well described by an extended Su--Schrieffer--Heeger zigzag-ladder Hamiltonian. Scanning tunnelling spectroscopy (STS) and first-principles calculations show that the valence band edge of adjacent, connected semiconducting GNR segments lies close to $E_\mathrm{F}$ for the metallic segments. STS spectra recover bulk GNR properties within $\sim$1 nm on either side of the metal-semiconductor GNR interface, with no discernible depletion region. The observed GNR band edge alignment is consistent with a small energy barrier for hole injection, thus suggesting a possible route towards atomically precise, low-barrier p-type contacts for future GNR-based electronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过顺序表面合成结合STM诱导脱氢，在不改变宽度与碳骨架的前提下，将金属性7-iGNR片段"写入"半导体性H2-7-iGNR中，实现了原子级精确的金属-半导体GNR界面，界面处无明显耗尽区，为低势垒p型接触提供可能。
AI.motivation: GNR是高度可调的一维量子材料，带隙与带边对齐已可精确控制，但构建高质量电子界面（如金属-半导体接触）仍是难点，尤其是实现低势垒、原子级精确的接触。
AI.method: 结合顺序表面合成与STM诱导脱氢，在不改变GNR宽度及碳骨架连接性的条件下，将金属性7-iGNR片段直接写入半导体性H2-7-iGNR中；采用STS与第一性原理计算表征电子结构，并用扩展的Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）锯齿梯子哈密顿量建模。
AI.result: 金属性片段在费米能级处呈现非零谱权重与空间扩展的电子态，符合两条色散带穿过EF；扩展SSH锯齿梯子模型能良好描述新出现的金属态；界面两侧约1 nm内STS即恢复体相GNR性质，无明显耗尽区；相邻半导体段价带边接近金属段的EF，对应较小的空穴注入势垒。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了原子级精确、低势垒的金属-半导体GNR界面，为未来GNR基电子器件的p型接触提供了可行路径。

title: Why polar excitons stay sharp: parity protection of the center-of-mass recoil channel in exciton-phonon scattering
summary: In polar semiconductors the Fröhlich interaction is the dominant electron--phonon coupling, yet excitonic resonances in materials such as halide perovskites remain anomalously sharp. We show that standard frozen-center-of-mass treatments of the exciton--phonon problem miss the decisive kinematic degree of freedom: restoring the exact center-of-mass (COM) recoil reveals a universally open, parameter-free $1s\to1s$ absorption channel at recoil momentum $q_*=\sqrt{2M_{\rm ex}\hbarω_{\rm LO}}/\hbar$, whose rate scales as $N_{\rm LO}(T)$. We prove that this recoil channel is controlled by destructive electron--hole interference: the recoil linewidth vanishes with the mass asymmetry as $γ_{\rm LO}^{\rm recoil}\propto\mathcal{F}_{1s,1s}(q_*)^2$, and the elastic dressing obeys the exact suppression law $S_X/S_{\rm ind}=η^2(6-η^2)/5$ within the hydrogenic Fröhlich model. The theory establishes a hierarchy of scattering regimes. In mass-asymmetric materials (GaAs, $η=-0.74$) the recoil channel is active ($γ_{\rm LO}^{\rm recoil}=2.2$~meV); in mass-symmetric materials (FAPbI$_3$, $η=0$; MAPbI$_3$, $η=-0.11$) it is killed by interference (0.00 and 0.12 meV), showing that the observed 27--40 meV perovskite linewidths cannot be accounted for by COM recoil and therefore require internal-state-changing and other inelastic channels, of which the constructive, $η$-robust $1s\to np$ resonance is the leading candidate within the present model. The Fröhlich constant $α$ alone is therefore insufficient as a figure of merit: after projection onto the correlated exciton, the controlling parameters are $η$, $q_*a_X$, and the Rydberg detuning.

AI.tldr: 恢复激子质心反冲自由度后，Fröhlich耦合出现一个普适开放的1s→1s吸收通道，其线宽由电子-空穴干涉决定，可用质量不对称参数η描述。
AI.motivation: 卤化物钙钛矿等极性半导体中Fröhlich相互作用应是主导的电子-声子耦合，但激子共振却异常尖锐；标准冻结质心处理方法遗漏了关键的质心反冲运动学自由度，无法解释该反常现象。
AI.method: 在氢样Fröhlich模型中恢复精确的质心反冲，推导反冲动量q*=√(2M_ex ℏω_LO)/ℏ处的1s→1s吸收通道；用电子-空穴干涉（质量不对称η）解析刻画线宽、弹性缀饰抑制律S_X/S_ind=η²(6-η²)/5，并投影到关联激子态上分析η、q*a_X和Rydberg失谐等控制参数。
AI.result: 该反冲通道速率随N_LO(T)变化，线宽随质量不对称以γ_LO^recoil∝F_{1s,1s}(q*)²消失。质量不对称材料GaAs (η=-0.74)反冲通道活跃，线宽2.2 meV；质量对称材料FAPbI₃ (η=0)和MAPbI₃ (η=-0.11)线宽近乎为零（0.00、0.12 meV）。故27–40 meV的钙钛矿线宽不能由质心反冲解释，需内部态改变等非弹性通道，其中构造性且对η鲁棒的1s→np共振是主要候选。
AI.conclusion: 仅用Fröhlich常数α不足以作为品质因子；投影到关联激子后，真正控制散射的是η、q*a_X和Rydberg失谐。理论建立了散射区域层级，表明钙钛矿激子线宽需归因于内部态改变的通道而非质心反冲。

title: Landau-like formalism for the thermal-runaway and filamentation instabilities in switching Mott devices
summary: Correlated oxides can switch to a low-resistance state when exposed to a voltage, making these insulator-to-metal transition materials promising candidates for memristor technology. Switching in materials such as VO2 occurs because of a thermal-runaway instability that leads to the abrupt formation of a hot current-carrying metallic filament within the insulator. We study, theoretically and experimentally, this bias-induced switching as a non-linear dynamics stability problem. We construct Landau free energy-like Lyapunov functions to show that both the on-state ("set") and the off-state ("reset") transitions can be described as separate saddle-node bifurcations. Starting from the reaction-diffusion equation for the heat transport, the abrupt snap-back (reset) to the insulating state is systematically formulated as a mean field Landau-like dynamics with the filament width playing the role of the order parameter. The formulation predicts an abrupt first-order phase transition with a break-off of a finite width filament across the current-controlled reset transition. The formulation is quantitatively compared against our electrical and optical microscopy experiments on VO2 thin film devices. Multi-cycle switching dynamics experiments further reveal the emergence of a stable stochastic regime following an initial electro-spatial forming phase. Beyond establishing a cross-disciplinary dynamical framework that may be readily compared to instabilities in various reaction-diffusion scenarios, the work also provides a predictive foundation for the rational design and optimization of Mott-transition-based technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文用非线性动力学稳定性理论统一描述VO2等关联氧化物记忆电阻的电压诱导绝缘体-金属转变，将set/reset过程建模为鞍结分岔，并用Landau型平均场理论解释reset的突变行为，与实验吻合。
AI.motivation: 关联氧化物（如VO2）可用于记忆电阻技术，其开关源于热失控形成金属丝。作者希望超越唯象描述，用非线性动力学框架统一理解开关机制，并为Mott转变器件设计提供预测基础。
AI.method: 从热输运的反应-扩散方程出发，构建Landau自由能式Lyapunov函数，将on（set）和off（reset）转变分别建模为鞍结分岔；以金属丝宽度为序参量建立平均场Landau型动力学，并与VO2薄膜器件的电学和光学显微实验进行定量对比，以及多循环开关动力学研究。
AI.result: 理论预测reset为突然的一阶相变，伴随有限宽度金属丝的断裂；该预测与VO2薄膜器件的电气和光学显微实验定量一致。多循环实验显示，在初始电-空间形成阶段后出现稳定的随机开关区域。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了可与其他反应-扩散不稳定性现象类比跨学科动力学框架，并为Mott转变技术的理性设计和优化提供了预测性基础。

title: Phonon interference induced by defect pairs
summary: The coherent dynamics of lattice waves is of significant importance for exploring the nonadiabatic phenomena of the electron-phonon coupling under nonequilibrium conditions. Here, we propose a theoretical model for phonon interference induced by a defect pair, in which lattice waves with the selective modes are launched independently by each of defects due to the strongly local electron-phonon coupling. We find that the intensities of phonon interference fringes could be directly evaluated by a measurable quantity in experiments--Huang-Rhys factor, and the geometry of interference patterns could be modified by the internal parameters of defect pair, including the charge states, spatial distance, energy-level depth and localization strength. In particular, several novel quantum states, such as the Dirac-like and nodal-line topological states are emerged for the appropriate internal parameters. Furthermore, using Huang-Rhys model, we simulate the ultrafast optical spectroscopy in the phonon interference duration when defect pairs are excited as the color centers, where interference fringes are perfectly matched by intensities of spectrum, similar to the $\textit{lock-key}$ pattern. These results show that defect pair, serving as the driven force for the coherent dynamical processes for multidegrees of freedom, offers an ideal platform to explore fundamental quantum phenomena in nonequilibrium and ultrafast physics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出缺陷对诱导声子干涉的理论模型，发现干涉条纹强度可由Huang-Rhys因子直接评估，并可通过缺陷对内部参数调控，出现Dirac型和节线型拓扑态。
AI.motivation: 晶格波相干动力学对研究非平衡条件下电子-声子耦合的非绝热现象具有重要意义，缺陷对可作为多自由度相干动力学过程的驱动源。
AI.method: 建立缺陷对诱导声子干涉的理论模型，利用强局域电子-声子耦合使各缺陷独立发射选择性模式的晶格波；采用Huang-Rhys模型模拟缺陷对作为色心被激发时的超快光学光谱。
AI.result: 干涉条纹强度可由实验中可测的Huang-Rhys因子直接评估；干涉图样几何可被缺陷对的电荷态、空间距离、能级深度和局域强度调控；在合适参数下出现Dirac型和节线型拓扑态；光谱强度与干涉条纹完美匹配，呈lock-key模式。
AI.conclusion: 缺陷对作为多自由度相干动力学过程的驱动力，为探索非平衡与超快物理中的基本量子现象提供了理想平台。

title: Frustration-induced multiferroicity in hauerite MnS2
summary: Pyrite-type mineral hauerite MnS$_2$ is a magnetic insulator with localized $S=\frac52$ moments. Below 48 K, it develops a collinear antiferromagnetic order, accompanied by unit-cell doubling and breaking the inversion symmetry. We demonstrate that the latter gives rise to a ferroelectric polarization of up to 360 $μ$C/m$^2$ rendering MnS$_2$ a type-II multiferroic. Microscopically, the electronic polarization originates from S$_2$ dimers that acquire a dipole moment induced by the frustrated magnetic ordering of neighboring Mn sites. We show that time-reversal symmetry leaves ferroelectric domains intact, and that domain switching necessitates overcoming a high energy barrier set by the magnetic exchange energy scale.

AI.tldr: MnS₂是一种局域S=5/2磁矩的磁性绝缘体，48K以下形成共线反铁磁序并伴随晶胞加倍与反演对称性破缺，从而产生达360 μC/m²的铁电极化，使其成为第二类多铁材料。
AI.motivation: 研究MnS₂在磁有序下是否因对称性破缺而产生铁电极化，进而揭示其作为第二类多铁材料的可能性及微观机制。
AI.method: 从对称性分析与微观电子机制出发，探讨磁有序诱导的S₂二聚体偶极矩及时间反演对称性、畴翻转能垒等行为。
AI.result: 48K以下形成共线反铁磁序，晶胞加倍并破坏反演对称性，产生最高360 μC/m²的铁电极化；极化源于邻近Mn位点受挫磁序诱导的S₂二聚体偶极矩；时间反演对称性保持铁电畴不变，畴翻转需克服由磁交换能标决定的高能垒。
AI.conclusion: MnS₂是一种由磁序驱动极化的第二类多铁材料，其铁电性与磁交换耦合紧密关联。

title: Topo-Spectral Percolation Descriptors for Mechanistic Ion Transport Pathways from Static Crystal Structures
summary: Ion transport controls the macroscopic performance of solid electrolytes, battery electrodes, ion-selective membranes, electrolysis ceramics, mixed conductors, porous sorbents, and biological channels. In each case, ion transport is determined by structural characteristics, namely the available diffusion pathways and the specific bottleneck atoms that limit the ionic jumps. These are intrinsic properties of the crystalline framework, whereas temperature, carrier concentration, and correlated motion govern the transport rate. Ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) resolves the mechanism directly but is too costly for materials screening, and most surrogate models give only a single transport number. Here we present a calibration-free method for determining the mechanism, based on Topo-Spectral Percolation Descriptors (TSPD). TSPD obtains the transport mechanism from a single static structure in seconds. It constructs a periodic migration network whose edge barriers are computed from physics-based energetics. We then analyze the barrier-threshold topology of this network and the spectrum of its barrier-weighted graph Laplacian. To establish its validity for computational solid-state ionics, we test TSPD against AIMD ion densities and neutron diffraction data for eight materials, including cathodes and solid electrolytes, whose transport ranges from one- to three-dimensional. TSPD reproduces the established mechanism in every case and correctly identifies structures in which geometric openness does not imply viable ion percolation. The method is most informative for pathway-limited, direction-dependent transport, and it complements full dynamical simulations for strongly cooperative or nearly isotropic transport.

AI.tldr: 本文提出无需校准的Topo-Spectral Percolation Descriptors (TSPD)方法，从单个静态结构在秒级时间内确定固态离子材料的输运机制。
AI.motivation: 离子输运决定固体电解质、电极、离子选择膜等众多材料的宏观性能，而输运机制由结构特征（扩散路径与限速瓶颈原子）决定。第一性原理分子动力学(AIMD)虽能直接解析机制但成本过高，不适合材料筛选；现有代理模型往往只能给出单一输运数值，无法揭示机制。
AI.method: 构建周期性迁移网络，其边势垒由基于物理的能量学计算得到；随后分析该网络在势垒阈值下的拓扑结构，以及势垒加权图拉普拉斯算子的谱，从而由单一静态结构提取输运机制。
AI.result: 针对八种材料（包括正极与固体电解质，输运维度从一维到三维），以AIMD离子密度和中子衍射数据为基准进行验证。TSPD在每种情况下都复现了已知机制，并能正确识别几何开放但不存在可行离子渗透的结构。
AI.conclusion: TSPD对路径受限、方向依赖的输运最为有效，可作为强协同或近各向同性输运情形下全动力学模拟的补充手段，为计算固态离子学提供快速、无需校准的机制判定工具。

title: Composite fermions in ideal Chern bands
summary: The composite-fermion framework maps the strongly correlated fractional quantum Hall state onto a weakly interacting integer quantum Hall state in a reduced effective magnetic field. We ask how this framework is modified for fractional Chern insulators, where the role of a uniform magnetic field is replaced by the nonuniform Berry curvature of a Chern band. Specifically, we construct composite-fermion wave functions for Jain states and their quasiparticles and quasiholes in Aharonov-Casher bands, a widely used model for ideal Chern bands. We find that these states overlap closely with exact eigenstates over a broad range of field modulation. Using these wave functions, we demonstrate that the emergent composite-fermion band structure goes beyond the conventional picture of effective Landau levels, correctly capturing the quasiparticle dispersion. Remarkably, we find that an isolated quasiparticle band carries a total Berry flux that is different from a Landau level. These results establish a composite-fermion description for mobile fractional Chern insulator anyons and provide a framework to understand their stability.

AI.tldr: 本文将复合费米子框架推广到分数量子反常霍尔绝缘体，在Aharonov-Casher能带中构造了Jain态及其准粒子/准空穴波函数，发现其与精确本征态高度重合，并揭示准粒子能带携带的Berry通量不同于朗道能级。
AI.motivation: 复合费米子框架成功地将强关联分数量子霍尔态映射为约化有效磁场中的弱相互作用整数量子霍尔态，但在分数量子反常霍尔绝缘体中，均匀磁场的角色被Chern能带的非均匀Berry曲率取代，该框架如何被修改尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在Aharonov-Casher能带（理想Chern能带的常用模型）中构造Jain态及其准粒子和准空穴的复合费米子波函数，并在较宽的场调制范围内与精确本征态进行对比。
AI.result: 复合费米子波函数在较宽场调制范围内与精确本征态高度重合；涌现的复合费米子能带结构超越了传统有效朗道能级图像，能正确描述准粒子色散；一个孤立的准粒子能带携带的总Berry通量不同于朗道能级。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了可移动分数量子反常霍尔绝缘体任意子的复合费米子描述，并提供了理解其稳定性的理论框架。

title: Additive solid immersion lenses for enhanced collection efficiency of shallow NV centers by pulsed laser deposition and structurization of high-k amorphous oxides
summary: The negatively charged nitrogen-vacancy ($\mathrm{NV}^-$) defect in diamond can be used for quantum information processing via the readout of the radiative decay of the excited state into the ground state. The large refractive index mismatch of diamond and air causes low photon extraction efficiency due to total internal reflection losses. Here, we investigate the photon extraction numerically and report additive solid immersion lenses (SILs) consisting of the high-k dielectric yttria-stabilized-zirconia (YSZ) for surface modification and enhanced light extraction of shallow implanted nitrogen-vacancy centers. We demonstrate an average increase of 63% in saturation intensity using a scalable bottum up room temperature pulsed laser deposition and photolithography structurization process. The average necessary laser intensity for saturation is reduced by 33% by the SILs.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究通过在金刚石表面添加YSZ材料制成的固态浸没透镜(SIL)，以提高NV⁻色心的光子提取效率。
AI.motivation: 金刚石与空气的折射率差异大，导致全内反射损耗，从而降低NV⁻色心的光子提取效率。
AI.method: 采用室温脉冲激光沉积和光刻结构化工艺，在金刚石表面制备高k介电材料YSZ的固态浸没透镜(SIL)，并进行数值模拟。
AI.result: 使用SIL后，饱和强度平均提升63%，达到饱和所需的平均激光强度降低33%。
AI.conclusion: YSZ基SIL可有效增强浅层植入NV色心的光提取效率，且工艺具有可扩展性。

title: Pressure induced structural transitions, coordination crossover, and optoelectronic response in divalent metavanadate CaV$_2$O$_6$
summary: High-pressure synchrotron X-ray diffraction, Raman spectroscopy, photoluminescence (PL), and UV-Vis absorption measurements were carried out on the divalent metavanadate CaV$_2$O$_6$ up to 31 GPa at room temperature. Ambient CaV$_2$O$_6$ crystallizes in a centrosymmetric pseudo-brannerite monoclinic structure ($C2/m$), where vanadium atoms reside in fivefold-coordinated VO$_5$ trigonal bipyramids. Under hydrostatic compression, the system undergoes a structural phase transition starting at $\sim$1 GPa to a lower-symmetry, non-centrosymmetric monoclinic phase ($C2$), which becomes the single stable phase above 5.2 GPa. This transition involves an increase in vanadium coordination from VO$_5$ bipyramids to edge-sharing distorted VO$_6$ octahedra. High-pressure Raman scattering corroborates the structural phase boundaries, exhibiting mode softening ($γ_3 = -0.42$, $γ_9 = -0.46$) within the mixed-phase regime (1.0 - 4.4 GPa) and sharp anomalies in mode frequencies and linewidths across 5.2 GPa. The optical measurements show complete PL quenching near 1 GPa due to non-radiative recombination pathways introduced by local polyhedral distortions, alongside a non-monotonic evolution of the indirect optical band gap. Above 20 GPa, an anomaly in polyhedral distortion and internal strain drives an isosymmetric structural modification within the $C2$ phase, marked by an alteration in bulk compressibility and stabilization of the optical gap. Comparative high-pressure band-gap measurements on the sister compound MgV$_2$O$_6$ validate the explicit coupling between cation coordination changes and optoelectronic response in divalent metavanadates.

AI.tldr: 高压下CaV2O6发生VO5→VO6配位转变的非对称相变，并伴随光学性质变化。
AI.motivation: 探究高压下二价偏钒酸盐的结构稳定性及配位变化与光电响应的耦合关系。
AI.method: 在室温、最高31 GPa下进行同步辐射XRD、拉曼、光致发光和UV-Vis吸收测量。
AI.result: ~1 GPa开始由C2/m转变为C2相，5.2 GPa以上单一稳定；钒由VO5转变为VO6；PL在~1 GPa猝灭；20 GPa以上发生等对称结构修饰。
AI.conclusion: 配位变化与光电响应存在明确耦合，MgV2O6对比结果予以验证。

title: Symmetry considerations in chirality-induced spin selectivity
summary: The chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS) effect, the coupling between structural chirality and electron spin polarization, has been experimentally observed across many diverse systems. However, despite extensive theoretical effort, a unified mechanistic understanding remains elusive. In this perspective, we demonstrate how some of the basic properties of the fascinating effects of CISS can be understood based on straightforward symmetry considerations commonly employed in fundamental particle physics. In particular, we show that CISS does not violate any fundamental symmetries including parity and time-reversal. By anchoring CISS within the universal language of symmetry, we offer a robust conceptual foundation for interpreting experiments and guiding future theoretical and experimental designs.

AI.tldr: 本文从基本粒子物理中常用的对称性角度出发，指出手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应并不违反宇称和时间反演等基本对称性，为理解该效应提供统一的对称性框架。
AI.motivation: CISS效应已在多种体系中实验观测到，但尽管有大量理论研究，仍缺乏统一的机制理解。
AI.method: 采用基础粒子物理中常见的对称性分析，特别是宇称和时间反演对称性，对CISS效应的基本性质进行论证。
AI.result: 证明CISS并不违反任何基本对称性，包括宇称和时间反演对称性。
AI.conclusion: 以对称性这一普适语言锚定CISS，为解释实验及指导未来理论与实验设计提供稳健的概念基础。

title: Transport theory for a generic two-arm co-propagating Majorana interferometer with Majorana fermion and edge vortex tunneling
summary: Co-propagating chiral Majorana edge modes are predicted to exist in proximity-coupled quantum anomalous Hall systems. They combine the exciting prospects of edge vortices as flying non-Abelian Ising anyons, with their fully electrical detection through anyon fusion processes. In this setup, electrical transport arises from the interference of a pair of Majorana edge states. By bosonizing the model with an additional replica sector, we generalize previous treatments to fully asymmetric configurations. We analyze a Mach-Zehnder interferometer and show that while the DC conductance does not exhibit signatures of edge-vortex interference, at low frequencies, this interference manifests as an effective capacitance. This quantity is sensitive to the non-Abelian anyon statistics of edge vortices and, in particular, carries signatures of their topological spin and nontrivial conformal dimension. We demonstrate that the thermal length $l_T = \hbar v/(πk_B T)$ is the relevant scale at low temperatures $T$, analogous to quasiparticle transport in conventional quantum Hall edge states with velocity $v$. As long as the interferometer arm lengths match within this length scale, transport signatures of the non-Abelian statistics of edge vortices remain visible.

AI.tldr: 研究近邻耦合量子反常霍尔系统中手性马约拉纳边缘模式，通过引入额外复本扇区的玻色化方法，将干涉理论推广到完全非对称构型，发现低频有效电容可探测边缘涡旋的非阿贝尔统计。
AI.motivation: 共传播手性马约拉纳边缘模式可实现对边缘涡旋（飞行非阿贝尔Ising任意子）的全电学探测，但以往理论多限于对称构型，需推广到更一般的完全非对称情形并寻找可观测的电学信号。
AI.method: 对模型引入额外复本扇区进行玻色化，推广至完全非对称构型，并分析Mach-Zehnder干涉仪；重点考察DC电导与低频响应，引入热长度 l_T = ħv/(πk_B T) 作为低温特征尺度。
AI.result: DC电导不显示边缘涡旋干涉特征；但在低频下，干涉表现为有效电容，该量对非阿贝尔任意子统计敏感，携带拓扑自旋与非平凡共形维数的信号。热长度是低温下的相关尺度，只要干涉仪两臂长度在该尺度内匹配，非阿贝尔统计的输运信号仍可见。
AI.conclusion: 低频有效电容可作为探测边缘涡旋非阿贝尔统计（拓扑自旋与共形维数）的电学探针，且该信号在干涉仪臂长匹配于热长度范围内可保持可见。

title: Domain-engineered ferroelectric BiFeO$_3$ thin films for efficient bias-free THz emission
summary: Ultrashort light pulses can drive transient photocurrents in solids, the basis of modern terahertz (THz) emitters. Ferroelectrics have recently emerged in this context as sources that require neither the bias voltage of photoconductive antennas nor the magnetic field of spintronic emitters, yet the ultrafast photocurrent generating the emission has remained debated. Here, we resolve this question in epitaxial BiFeO$_3$ thin films with engineered ferroelectric domain configurations, from single-domain to periodic stripe patterns. The stripe-domain film emits a THz field four times stronger than the single-domain configurations, reaching about half the output of a metallic spintronic reference emitter while remaining unsaturated at our highest excitation fluences. Resolving the emitted THz field in amplitude and phase as a function of the pump light polarization and the crystal orientation, we separate the coexisting photocurrents by their symmetry. This identifies the ultrafast screening of the ferroelectric polarization by photocarriers as the dominant emission mechanism in the in-plane-polarized films, enhanced in multidomain films by the strong built-in fields at the domain walls, while an out-of-plane polarization favors the bulk photovoltaic current. Our results establish the ferroelectric domain configuration as a design parameter setting both the strength and the microscopic origin of light-driven THz emission.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对称性分析，分离了铁电BiFeO₃薄膜中并存的超快光电流，确定光载流子对铁电极化的超快屏蔽效应是面内极化薄膜中太赫兹发射的主导机制，且多畴结构可显著增强发射。
AI.motivation: 铁电体作为太赫兹发射源无需偏压或磁场，具有应用前景，但其超快光电流的产生机制一直存在争议，亟需厘清。
AI.method: 制备具有不同铁电畴构型（单畴到周期条纹畴）的外延BiFeO₃薄膜；通过将发射太赫兹场的振幅与相位作为泵浦光偏振和晶体取向的函数进行测量，按对称性分离并存的多种光电流。
AI.result: 条纹畴薄膜的太赫兹场比单畴构型强四倍，达到金属自旋电子参考发射器约一半的输出，且在最高激发通量下仍未饱和；面内极化薄膜以光载流子对极化的超快屏蔽为主导机制，多畴薄膜中畴壁的强内建电场增强该机制，而面外极化则有利于体光伏电流。
AI.conclusion: 铁电畴构型是同时决定光驱动太赫兹发射强度与微观起源的设计参数。

title: Sector-Resolved Winding Selection Rules for Structured-Light-Driven dc Currents
comment: 43 pages, 11 figures (7-page main text plus 36-page Supplemental Material)
summary: Structured light can generate electronic dc currents with azimuthal winding, yet the rules governing their winding order $m$ remain unclear. Here we identify sector-resolved winding selection rules using graphene as a clean two-dimensional platform. By decomposing the current response into local and gradient sectors at the current-operator level, we show that the winding order is determined not by the optical orbital angular momentum $\ell$ alone, but by the angular structure of the corresponding current operators together with projection onto the azimuthal direction. For scalar Laguerre-Gaussian beams, linear polarization yields $m=|\ell\pm1|$ in the local sector and $m=|\ell|,|\ell\pm2|$ in the gradient sector, whereas circular polarization with helicity $σ=\pm1$ selects $m=|\ell-σ|$ in the local sector and $m=|\ell+2σ|$ in the gradient sector. Numerical time-evolution calculations verify these rules and further show that helicity can select an $m=0$ branch, producing an azimuthally uniform circulating current whose radial profile determines the axial magnetic field $B_z(z)$. Our results provide a sector-resolved organizing principle for classifying and controlling structured-light-driven dc currents with tailored winding structures.

AI.tldr: 本文以石墨烯为平台，揭示了结构光驱动直流电流的"分区分辨缠绕选择定则"：缠绕阶数$m$由电流算符角结构与方位投影共同决定，而非仅由光轨道角动量$\ell$决定。
AI.motivation: 结构光可产生带方位缠绕的直流电流，但支配其缠绕阶数$m$的规则尚不清晰，缺乏系统性的分类与控制原理。
AI.method: 以石墨烯为干净二维平台，将电流响应在电流算符层面分解为局域分区与梯度分区；对拉盖尔-高斯光束分别分析线偏振与圆偏振情形，并用数值时间演化计算验证。
AI.result: 标量LG光束线偏振时局域分区$m=|\ell\pm1|$、梯度分区$m=|\ell|,|\ell\pm2|$；圆偏振（螺旋度$σ=\pm1$）时局域分区$m=|\ell-σ|$、梯度分区$m=|\ell+2σ|$。数值计算验证了这些定则，并显示螺旋度可选出$m=0$分支，产生方位均匀的环流，其径向分布决定轴向磁场$B_z(z)$。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了一个分区分辨的组织原理，用于分类和调控具有定制缠绕结构的结构光驱动直流电流。

title: Benchmarking average atom potentials derived from atomic cluster expansions
summary: Average atom (A-atom) potentials provide a mean-field description of a chemically disordered alloy and are used to predict the properties of solid solutions without short-range order. Such potentials are usually averaged from an existing interatomic potential and are therefore only as accurate as the parent model. Accurate interatomic potentials are themselves difficult to parameterize and can require large training datasets. Here we benchmark a recently developed formalism that computes an exact A-atom potential directly from a linear atomic cluster expansion (ACE). We first fit a linear ACE to Fe-W data generated with an embedded atom method (EAM) potential. The resulting A-atom potential reproduces the properties of the disordered phase computed from an explicit random supercell and from a conventional A-atom potential averaged from the same EAM potential. We then fit a linear ACE to energies and forces computed from electronic structure calculations for about 1500 small Mo-Nb structures with an average of 7 atoms per structure. The A-atom potential derived from this ACE reproduces the DFT elastic constants, lattice parameter, mixing enthalpy, and Bain path of special quasirandom structures. Of the three chemical site bases, only the occupation basis also reproduces the DFT surface energies of the alloy. For Mo-Nb, the A-atom potential also predicts that the ideal solution entropy outweighs the destabilizing vibrational contribution to the finite-temperature free energy of the disordered phase. These benchmarks show that the properties of disordered alloys can be recovered from small training datasets when the chemical site basis is chosen carefully.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了一种从线性ACE势直接计算精确平均原子(A-atom)势的新方法，证明用小型训练数据集即可准确预测无序合金性质。
AI.motivation: 传统A-atom势由现有原子间势平均得到，精度受限于母模型，而精确的原子间势参数化困难且需大量训练数据。作者希望验证能否直接从线性ACE构建精确A-atom势，减少对大数据集的依赖。
AI.method: 先用EAM生成的Fe-W数据拟合线性ACE，比较所得A-atom势与显式随机超胞及传统A-atom势的结果；再用约1500个平均7原子的Mo-Nb结构DFT能量和力拟合线性ACE，并测试三种化学位点基组。
AI.result: Fe-W中，ACE导出的A-atom势重现了无序相性质。Mo-Nb中，该势重现DFT弹性常数、晶格参数、混合焓及Bain路径；三种化学位点基组中仅占据基能重现DFT表面能。该势还预测理想溶液熵超过振动贡献，稳定无序相。
AI.conclusion: 只要仔细选择化学位点基组，小型训练数据集即可恢复无序合金性质，验证了该精确A-atom势形式化的有效性。

title: Parafermions in fractional Chern insulator-superconductor heterostructures: the role of spin polarization
summary: Most proposals for $Z_3$ parafermions in fractional quantum Hall-superconductor structures used the spin-unpolarized $ν= 2/3$ Halperin $(1,1,2)$ state. The fractional quantum anomalous Hall (FQAH) states of twisted MoTe$_2$ and rhombohedral graphene are believed to be spin- and valley-polarized Jain states, with the same topological order but a different spin structure. We analyze a trench between two polarized $ν= 2/3$ edges. Among the pairing and tunneling bilinears of the edge-mode electrons, exactly two of each have zero conformal spin. Pairing is compatible only with the neutral-mode superconductivity channel and tunneling only with neutral-mode backscattering, whereas in the unpolarized state singlet pairing and tunneling select the same channel. Since the two channels condense the same neutral anyon up to a local operator, the domain walls carry $Z_3$ parafermions, with 3 protected states per pair, whether or not the neutral channel changes between regions; fixing the fermion parity does not enlarge this count. Before the neutral gap forms, pairing is at best marginal for repulsive inter-edge coupling unless an attractive neutral coupling favors its channel; once the gap has formed, both charge terms are relevant for an inter-edge Coulomb coupling below 7/25 of the intra-edge one. The superconductor must supply even-frequency, equal-spin, intravalley pairing, which an s-wave singlet superconductor with only Ising spin-orbit coupling does not provide at leading order, whereas chiral $p+ip$ and $f+if$ states do. The $Z_3$ label is carried by a quasiparticle of the FQAH state, so no process confined to a junction whose tunneling segments are not FQAH can change it, and we expect a $6π$-periodic Josephson current with or without fixed fermion parity.

AI.tldr: 本文分析自旋/谷极化 ν=2/3 FQAH 边缘间沟槽，发现中性模式配对/隧穿通道可产生 Z3 parafermion 畴壁，并给出对超导配对对称性和约瑟夫森效应的预言。
AI.motivation: 传统 Z3 parafermion 方案多基于自旋非极化 ν=2/3 Halperin (1,1,2) 态，而 MoTe2 与菱面石墨烯中的 FQAH 态虽拓扑序相同却自旋、谷极化，边缘模式与配对性质不同，需重新分析其能否承载 Z3 parafermion。
AI.method: 研究两条极化 ν=2/3 边缘间沟槽，枚举边缘电子配对与隧穿双线性算符的共形自旋；比较极化与非极化态中零共形自旋通道；分析中性通道凝聚与畴壁任意子，并讨论相关重整化、Coulomb 耦合及超导配对对称性。
AI.result: 每个类型恰好两个双线性算符共形自旋为零；配对准许中性模式超导通道，隧穿只容许中性模式背散射，而非极化态中单态配对与隧穿选择同一通道。两通道凝聚同一中性任意子，畴壁承载 Z3 parafermion，每对 3 个受保护态，固定费米子宇称不增加计数。中性能隙形成前，排斥性边缘耦合下配对至多边缘；能隙形成后，当边缘间 Coulomb 耦合小于边缘内耦合的 7/25 时两个电荷项均相关。超导需提供偶频、等自旋、谷内配对，Ising 自旋轨道耦合 s 波单态不支持，手征 p+ip 与 f+if 可支持。Z3 标签由 FQAH 准粒子携带，非 FQAH 结隧穿段无法改变；预期无论是否固定费米子宇称均呈 6π 周期约瑟夫森电流。
AI.conclusion: 极化 ν=2/3 FQAH 边缘为 Z3 parafermion 实现提供可行平台，且对超导配对对称性与约瑟夫森周期有明确、可检验的预言。

title: Complex magnetic phase diagrams in Tb$_2$IrAl$_4$Ge$_2$ and Er$_2$IrAl$_4$Ge$_2$
summary: We report the synthesis and comprehensive investigation of single-crystalline Tb$_2$IrAl$_4$Ge$_2$ and Er$_2$IrAl$_4$Ge$_2$, the first Ir-based members of the $Ln_2M$Al$_4$Ge$_2$ family. Both compounds crystallize in the tetragonal Tb$_2$NiAl$_4$Ge$_2$-type structure (space group $I4/mmm$) and exhibit easy-axis magnetic anisotropy with the crystallographic $c$ axis as the preferred magnetization direction. Tb$_2$IrAl$_4$Ge$_2$ undergoes antiferromagnetic ordering below $T_N = 25$ K and develops a sequence of field-induced metamagnetic transitions accompanied by pronounced magnetotransport anomalies, including a nonlinear Hall response. In contrast, Er$_2$IrAl$_4$Ge$_2$ exhibits three successive zero-field magnetic transitions and a substantially richer low-temperature magnetic phase diagram comprising multiple competing field-induced phases confined to relatively modest magnetic fields. The differences between the Tb- and Er-based compounds demonstrate the wide range of magnetic behavior that can be realized within the \ce{Tb2NiAl4Ge2}-type structure. More broadly, the successful realization of Ir-based $Ln_2M$Al$_4$Ge$_2$ compounds considerably expands the accessible chemical space of this family and opens a route toward the exploration of related $4d$- and $5d$-based aluminogermanides.

AI.tldr: 首次合成并研究Ir基Ln2MAl4Ge2家族成员Tb2IrAl4Ge2与Er2IrAl4Ge2，二者均为四方Tb2NiAl4Ge2型结构，表现出沿c轴易磁化轴各向异性，但磁性行为差异显著。
AI.motivation: 拓展Ln2MAl4Ge2家族化学空间，探索Ir基（4d/5d）铝锗化合物的磁性行为，此前该家族尚无Ir基成员。
AI.method: 合成单晶Tb2IrAl4Ge2与Er2IrAl4Ge2，通过结构表征及磁化、磁输运（含霍尔响应）等综合测量进行研究。
AI.result: 两化合物结晶于I4/mmm空间群，具c轴易磁化轴各向异性；Tb基在TN=25 K以下反铁磁有序，伴随场诱导变磁转变及非线性霍尔等磁输运异常；Er基出现三个零场磁转变，低温相图更丰富，含多个在中等磁场内的竞争场诱导相。
AI.conclusion: Tb与Er基化合物磁性差异显著，表明该结构类型可实现多样磁行为；Ir基Ln2MAl4Ge2的成功制备扩展了该家族化学空间，并为探索相关4d/5d基铝锗化合物开辟途径。

title: Single-Pulse Optical Switching combined with Current-Induced Motion of Skyrmionic Spin Textures
comment: 16 pages (main) + 5 pages (supporting information). 5 figures (main) + 4 figures (supporting information). Submitted to Advanced Materials
summary: Magnetic skyrmions are promising nanoscale information carriers because their position can be manipulated by electrical currents. The additional ability of deterministic control of the spin structure would allow the use of magnetic skyrmions as multi-state bits, expanding the capabilities of skyrmion devices further. Such control could be realized by coupling all-optical helicity independent switching of magnetization (AO-HIS) to magnetic skyrmions. This is realized in a Pt/Ir/CoB/Gd/Pt multilayer that is engineered to stabilize magnetic skyrmions and, at the same time, enable AO-HIS by single ultrafast laser pulse. Laser excitation is used to write skyrmionic textures, whose polarity is selected by a small applied out-of-plane field. A single 30 fs laser pulse is then used to toggle the magnetization of an illuminated region containing skyrmionic textures, reversing their polarities without requiring any magnetic field or current pulses. This establishes deterministic optical switching of the skyrmion spin structure as a new manipulation channel, distinct from previously reported optical nucleation and annihilation. The material is then patterned into a wire, to combine the optical manipulation with current-induced skyrmion motion. These results establish a route toward opto-spintronic skyrmion devices in which light programs the internal state of a skyrmion and electrical currents control its position.

AI.tldr: 通过耦合全光无螺旋度磁化翻转(AO-HIS)与磁性斯格明子，在Pt/Ir/CoB/Gd/Pt多层膜中实现单脉冲激光确定性翻转斯格明子极性，并可与电流驱动运动结合，迈向光自旋电子斯格明子器件。
AI.motivation: 磁性斯格明子可作为纳米信息载体，其位置可由电流操控。若能额外确定性控制其自旋结构，则可作为多态比特，扩展器件能力，如实现"光写入内态+电流控制位置"。
AI.method: 设计Pt/Ir/CoB/Gd/Pt多层膜，同时稳定斯格明子并支持单超快激光脉冲的AO-HIS。用激光写入斯格明子织构，极性由小面外场选择；再用单个30 fs激光脉冲翻转含斯格明子区域的磁化，随后将材料图形化为线以结合电流驱动运动。
AI.result: 单个30 fs激光脉冲可翻转斯格明子极性，无需磁场或电流脉冲；实现了确定性光开关斯格明子自旋结构，区别于以往的光学成核与湮灭。
AI.conclusion: 建立了光调控斯格明子内态的确定性光学操控通道，并为结合电流驱动运动的光自旋电子斯格明子器件提供了可行路径。

title: Decoding Thermal Stability: In situ Insights into Phase Controlled Phosphine-free Colloidal Bi-Te Nanosheets
summary: Bismuth telluride (Bi2Te3) is a prototypical V-VI semiconductor of interest for both thermoelectric and topological applications; however, phase-selective synthesis and thermal stability across the bismuth-telluride homologous series remain poorly understood. We report a facile and phosphine-free colloidal synthesis approach for a phase-selective synthesis of Bi2Te3, BiTe, and Bi4Te5 nanosheets with well-defined hexagonal morphology. By controlling precursor chemistry and reaction temperature, we achieved the selective formation of different phases within the (Bi2)m(Bi2Te3)n homologous series. Based on in situ heating studies, BiTe and Bi4Te5 nanosheets transform into Bi2Te3 at about 340 degree C, followed by preferential Te sublimation under vacuum or oxidation in air at higher temperatures. We discuss plausible mechanisms for these phase transformations. EDS analysis and FFT analysis of STEM images provide direct evidence for the temperature-dependent compositional and structural changes and highlight the close thermal relationship among these phases. These results not only advance fundamental understanding of phase stability and thermal behavior in bismuth-tellurides at the nanoscale but also establish a framework for understanding structural evolution in related homologous series, providing insights into their potential future applications in thermoelectric, spintronic, and topological systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文实现了Bi2Te3、BiTe和Bi4Te5纳米片的相选择性胶体合成，并揭示了它们随温度的结构与成分演变。
AI.motivation: Bi2Te3是重要的V-VI族半导体，但铋碲同系物的相选择性合成及热稳定性认识不足。
AI.method: 采用无膦胶体合成，通过调控前驱体化学与反应温度实现相选择性生长；结合原位加热、EDS与STEM图像FFT分析研究热行为。
AI.result: 成功合成具六边形形貌的Bi2Te3、BiTe、Bi4Te5纳米片；BiTe和Bi4Te5在约340°C转变为Bi2Te3，更高温下Te优先升华或氧化。
AI.conclusion: 深化了纳米尺度铋碲化物相稳定性与热行为的理解，为同系物结构演化及相关热电、自旋电子和拓扑应用提供框架。

title: Flux- and tunnel-parity-controlled Josephson nonreciprocity from singlet-triplet competition in a parallel double quantum dot
summary: Nonreciprocal supercurrents in interacting nanostructures can arise when the positive and negative critical currents probe inequivalent portions of a phase-dependent many-body spectrum. We study this mechanism in a parallel double-quantum-dot Josephson junction with strong intradot Coulomb repulsion, where local and non-local Cooper-pair transfer coexist. Using exact diagonalization of a zero-bandwidth Hamiltonian with explicit superconducting orbitals, we show that orbital flux and the gauge-invariant tunnel-sign parity control the interference between local Josephson processes and non-local exchange. For detuned dots, this produces flux-tunable singlet, triplet, and doublet ground-state spectral branches and two rectification regimes. Near the boundaries of the charge sector with singly occupied dots [(1,1) sector], doublet branches compete with singlet or triplet branches, yielding diode efficiencies approaching 40%. Within the triplet-dominated (1,1) sector, nearby singlet crossings asymmetrically reshape the ground-state envelope even when both critical-current extrema lie on the triplet-like branch, producing a broader response of order 10-15%.
